chapters.name: Looking for a job after university? First, get off the sofa New words

words.ex: The factory galvanize iron sheets to prevent rust.
words.ex_cn: 工厂对铁片进行镀锌以防止生锈。
words.en: To galvanize someone means to cause them to take action, for example by making them feel very excited, afraid, or angry.

words.tr: adj. 充满（不愉快事物）的；
words.ex: The journey was fraught with delays.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅程充满了延误。
words.en: If a situation or activity is fraught with problems or risks, it is full of them.

words.ex: He put on his mortarboard before the graduation ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在毕业典礼前戴上了学位帽。
words.en: A mortarboard is a type of hat with a flat, square top and a tassel, worn by students at graduation ceremonies. It is also a flat board used by bricklayers for holding mortar.

words.ex: My family came to my graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人来参加我的毕业典礼。
words.en: Graduation is the successful completion of a course of study at a university, college, or school, often marked by a ceremony.

words.tr:
n. 猛跌；衰退；萧条期
v. 急剧下降；暴跌；重重地坐下（或倒下）
words.ex: The company's sales went into a slump last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月，这家公司的销售额下滑了。
words.en: If something such as the value of something slumps, it falls suddenly and by a large amount.

words.tr: n. 接穗，幼枝；（尤指富家）子孙
words.ex: The scion of the family now runs the business.
words.ex_cn: 这个家族的后代现在经营着这家企业。
words.en: A scion is a descendent or heir, especially of a wealthy, aristocratic, or influential family.

words.tr:
n. 变种；变体
v. 改变；变化
words.ex: This butterfly has a rare morph with blue wings.
words.ex_cn: 这种蝴蝶有一种罕见的蓝色翅膀变种。
words.en: To morph means to change smoothly from one image to another by small gradual steps using computer animation techniques.

words.tr:
v. 咕哝；（猪等）打呼噜
n. 咕哝；呼噜声
words.ex: He grunted when he lifted the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬起沉重的箱子时咕哝了一声。
words.en: To make a low, short guttural sound, typically to express dissatisfaction or effort.

words.tr: n. 试验；检测；考试；测验； v. 试验；测试；“test”的现在分词；
words.ex: The testing of the new car took three months.
words.ex_cn: 新车的试验花了三个月。
words.en: The process of subjecting something to a test to determine its qualities or performance.

words.ex: He reverted to his old habits after the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 假期后，他恢复了旧习惯。
words.en: To return to a former state, practice, topic, etc.

words.tr:
v. 唠叨；喋喋不休；不断困扰
n. 老马；驽马；矮小马
words.ex: She nagged him to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 她不停地催他打扫房间。
words.en: If someone nags you, they keep asking you to do something you have not done yet or do not want to do.

words.tr: phrase. 文官制度；公务员体系；政府行政部门
words.ex: He spent his entire career in the civil service.
words.ex_cn: 他在文职部门度过了整个职业生涯。
words.en: The civil service is the body of government officials who are employed in civil occupations that are neither political nor judicial.

words.tr: adj. 分离的； v. 脱离；拆卸；分离；“detach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is detached from the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子与邻居的房子是分开的。
words.en: If someone is detached, they do not have any emotional interest in a situation and therefore can make fair decisions.

words.tr: adj. 由技术专家组成的
words.ex: The government's technocratic approach to policy-making was criticized for lacking democratic input.
words.ex_cn: 该政府在制定政策时的技术专家治国论方法因缺乏民主参与而受到批评。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by the government or control of society or industry by an elite of technical experts.

words.tr:
v. 细述；叙述
n. 叙述；重新计票
words.ex: He tried to recount the accident to the police.
words.ex_cn: 他试图向警察重新叙述那场事故。
words.en: To recount means to tell someone about something that happened, often in detail; or to count something again to make sure the number is correct.

words.tr: n. 事件；一集；一段经历；
words.ex: The accident was a sad episode in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他生命中的一件悲伤的事。
words.en: An episode is a part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio as one of a series, or a single event or group of related events.

words.ex: The cop stopped the car for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 警察因超速拦下了那辆车。
words.en: A cop is a police officer. To cop means to catch or arrest someone.

words.ex: We work during the daytime and rest at night.
words.ex_cn: 我们在白天工作，晚上休息。
words.en: The period of the day when there is natural light, from sunrise to sunset.

words.tr: adj. 无目的的；无目标的；漫无目的；
words.ex: He walked aimless through the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园里无目的地散步。
words.en: If someone is aimless, they do not seem to have a clear purpose or plan in their life.

words.ex: The teacher gave a comprehensive review before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试前给了一个全面的复习。
words.en: Something that is comprehensive includes everything that is needed or relevant.

words.ex: The dog ran to the backside of the house.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑到房子的后方。
words.en: The backside of something is the part of it that is furthest from the front.

words.ex: The job was a dead-end, offering no room for advancement.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作没有出路，没有晋升空间。
words.en: A dead-end is a situation, plan, or course of action that leads nowhere or is unlikely to lead to success.

words.ex: This puzzle is tricky for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个谜题对孩子来说很棘手。
words.en: If you describe a task or problem as tricky, you mean that it is difficult to deal with and requires careful thinking or skill.

words.ex: After the break, we will proceed with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 休息后，我们将继续开会。
words.en: If you proceed to do something, you continue to do it or start to do it after doing something else first.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生（或来临）的
words.ex: The upcoming meeting is on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 即将到来的会议在周五。
words.en: An upcoming event is one that is going to happen soon.

words.ex: The cutoff came when the rain stopped the game.
words.ex_cn: 当雨停了比赛时，比赛被中止了。
words.en: A cutoff is a point or level which is a limit to what can be done or allowed.

words.tr: n. 精神治疗医师；心理治疗师
words.ex: The psychotherapist helps people feel better.
words.ex_cn: 心理治疗师帮助人们感觉更好。
words.en: A psychotherapist is a person who treats mental illness by using psychological methods rather than medical means.

words.ex: The wound will heal in a few days.
words.ex_cn: 伤口几天后就会愈合。
words.en: To make or become healthy or whole again; to cure or recover from an injury or illness.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.tr: adv. 关键性地；至关重要地；
words.ex: It is crucially important to study every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天学习关键性地重要。
words.en: In a way that is extremely important or essential.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.tr:
n. 树液；
v. 使逐渐耗竭；使削弱；
words.ex: The tree releases sap in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在春天流出树液。
words.en: Sap is the watery fluid that circulates in the vascular system of a plant, carrying nutrients and sugars. It can also refer to the vitality or energy of a person or thing.

words.ex: He had a consultation with the doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他与医生进行了一次咨询。
words.en: A consultation is a meeting which is held to discuss something. Consultation is discussion about something that is still being planned.

words.tr: adj. 执意强求的；要强的
words.ex: He is too pushy when he asks for help.
words.ex_cn: 他请求帮助时太咄咄逼人了。
words.en: If you describe someone as pushy, you mean that they try in a forceful way to get things done as they would like or to increase their status or influence.

words.ex: He was wary of strangers who offered free gifts.
words.ex_cn: 他对那些提供免费礼物的陌生人保持谨慎。
words.en: If you are wary of something or someone, you are cautious because you do not know much about them and you believe they may be dangerous or cause problems.

words.ex: He listened sympathetically to her story.
words.ex_cn: 他同情地听她讲了自己的故事。
words.en: In a way that shows you understand and care about someone's suffering or problems.

words.ex: He had a setback when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，遇到了挫折。
words.en: A setback is an event that delays your progress or reverses some of the progress that you have made.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.tr:
v. 轻推；轻触；劝说；鼓动
n. 轻推；轻触；劝说；鼓动
words.ex: He gave me a nudge to start the project.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻推了我一下，让我开始这个项目。
words.en: If you nudge someone, you push them gently, usually with your elbow, in order to draw their attention to something.

words.tr:
n. 马鞍；鞍座
v. 给（马）装鞍
words.ex: The boy rode on a saddle on the horse.
words.ex_cn: 男孩骑在马的马鞍上。
words.en: A saddle is a seat for a rider on the back of a horse or other animal, or a similar seat on a bicycle or motorcycle. It can also refer to the act of putting a saddle on a horse or to burden someone with a responsibility.

words.tr:
n. 提倡者；
v. 提倡；
words.ex: He is an advocate for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 他是清洁用水的提倡者。
words.en: If you advocate a particular action or plan, you recommend it publicly.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an antidote for the poison.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一种解毒剂来对抗毒药。
words.en: An antidote is a substance that counteracts the effects of poison or something harmful.

words.ex: He showed apathy toward the news.
words.ex_cn: 他对这则新闻漠不关心。
words.en: Apathy is a lack of feeling, emotion, interest, or concern about something. It is a state of indifference, or the suppression of emotions such as concern, excitement, motivation, or passion.

words.ex: The birds flew through the aerial sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在空中飞翔。
words.en: An aerial is a wire or rod that sends or receives radio or television signals. As an adjective, aerial describes things that are in the air or related to the air.

words.ex: He took a photographic memory of the scene.
words.ex_cn: 他把场景记在了像照片一样的记忆里。
words.en: Relating to or used in photography; resembling a photograph in accuracy or detail.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.ex: The police found a corpse near the river.
words.ex_cn: 警察在河边发现了一具尸体。
words.en: A corpse is a dead body, especially the dead body of a human.

words.ex: The mortuary was filled with the bodies of the victims.
words.ex_cn: 停尸房里堆满了受害者的尸体。
words.en: A mortuary is a building or a room in a hospital where dead bodies are kept before they are buried or cremated.

chapters.name: Looking for a job after university? First, get off the sofa Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 观看；面向；旁观；看待
words.ex: They look on while the children play.
words.ex_cn: 他们看着孩子们玩耍。
words.en: To watch something happen without getting involved.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （尤指不情愿地）支付，花（钱）
words.ex: He had to fork out a large sum of money for the repairs.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不为修理支付了一大笔钱。
words.en: If you fork out for something, you spend a lot of money on it, often unwillingly.

words.ex: Please turn down the volume, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音量调低，太大声了。
words.en: To refuse or reject an offer or request; to reduce the volume, temperature, or intensity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 处于同样困境；同舟共济；境遇相同
words.ex: We're all in the same boat, so let's help each other out.
words.ex_cn: 我们都在同一条船上，所以让我们互相帮助吧。
words.en: In the same situation, especially an unpleasant one.

words.tr: phrase. 在酒吧里打啤酒；为顾客斟啤酒
words.ex: He pulls pints at the local pub every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上在当地的酒吧倒啤酒。
words.en: To serve beer, especially in a pub, by drawing it from a keg or cask.

words.tr: 短语动词. 回到原点；完成一个循环；情况经过一系列变化后又恢复到最初的状态
words.ex: After years of traveling, he has come full circle and returned to his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的旅行，他兜了一圈又回到了家乡。
words.en: To return to the original position or state after a series of events or changes.

words.tr: phrase. 采取温和/宽容的态度或立场（尤指在处理问题或对待他人时）
words.ex: The government decided to take a soft line on the issue to avoid escalating tensions.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定对这个问题采取温和态度，以避免紧张局势升级。
words.en: To adopt a lenient or conciliatory approach towards a situation or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 采取强硬立场；持严厉态度
words.ex: The government decided to take a hard line against the protesters.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定对抗议者采取强硬立场。
words.en: To adopt an uncompromising or strict approach or policy in dealing with a situation or person.

words.tr: phrase. 至少；无论如何；就算别的没有
words.ex: If nothing else, we should try to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 至少，我们应该尽力按时完成项目。
words.en: At the very least; used to suggest that there is one positive aspect to something, even if there are no others.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 恰当地表达；引起共鸣；把握恰当的语气或情感
words.ex: He struck the right note in the meeting and everyone agreed with him.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上说到了点子上，大家都同意他。
words.en: To say or do something that is exactly right or appropriate for a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 尽一切办法；务必；一定
words.ex: You can borrow my book by all means.
words.ex_cn: 你当然可以借我的书。
words.en: used to give permission or to say that you are willing to allow something to happen

words.ex: We need to talk through the plan before we start.
words.ex_cn: 在开始之前，我们需要把计划讨论一下。
words.en: To discuss something thoroughly in order to solve it or understand it better.

words.tr: phrase. 选择；追求；努力争取
words.ex: I want to go for the blue shirt.
words.ex_cn: 我对那件蓝色的衬衫感兴趣。
words.en: If you go for something, you choose it or try to achieve it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 选择某物；争取某事物；喜欢或支持某事物
words.ex: He wants to go for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他想争取那份工作。
words.en: To choose something; to try to achieve something; to like something.

chapters.name: If you ask me New words

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；困难；争吵
v. 烦扰；纠缠
words.ex: It's not worth the hassle to change your plans.
words.ex_cn: 改变计划不值得这么麻烦。
words.en: If you describe something as a hassle, you mean that it is inconvenient and annoying. As a verb, to hassle someone means to annoy or trouble them persistently.

words.tr:
adj. 内陆的；
adv. 向内地；在内陆；
n. 内地；内陆；
words.ex: The small village is located inland, far from the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于内陆，远离大海。
words.en: Inland means situated in the interior of a country rather than on the coast.

words.ex: He deducts tax from his salary every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月从工资中扣除税款。
words.en: If you deduct an amount from a total, you subtract it from the total.

words.ex: He made the repayment on time.
words.ex_cn: 他按时还款了。
words.en: The action of paying back a loan or the money that has been borrowed.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 房东修好了破掉的窗户。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns land or property and rents it out to others.

words.ex: He became a dropout after failing math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试不及格后退学了。
words.en: A dropout is a person who leaves school or college before they have finished their studies, especially because they are not interested in continuing.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.ex: He made a gamble on the horse race.
words.ex_cn: 他在这场赛马上赌了一把。
words.en: If you gamble on something, you take a risky action or decision in the hope of gaining something.

words.ex: Fortunately, the bus came just in time.
words.ex_cn: 幸运的是，公交车正好准时到了。
words.en: Used to say that something good has happened, especially when it could have been bad.

words.ex: He packed his belongings before moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他在搬去新城市前收拾好了自己的所有物。
words.en: Your belongings are the things that you own, especially things that are small enough to be carried.

words.ex: I need a photocopy of my passport.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一份护照的影印本。
words.en: A photocopy is a copy of a document made by a photocopier.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

words.ex: The lawyer helped her client with the contract.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助她的客户处理合同。
words.en: A client is a person or organization receiving services or advice from a professional or company.

words.tr: adj. 要求高的；费力的； v. 需要；“demand”的现在分词；
words.ex: The job is demanding because it needs long hours and high focus.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作要求高，因为它需要长时间工作和高度专注。
words.en: Requiring much effort or attention; exacting.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: He gets his money on payday.
words.ex_cn: 他在发薪日拿到工资。
words.en: The day on which someone receives their wages or salary.

words.ex: He is her boyfriend.
words.ex_cn: 他是她的男朋友。
words.en: A boyfriend is a man or boy with whom someone is having a romantic or sexual relationship.

words.ex: He posted an anonymous comment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上发布了一条匿名评论。
words.en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

words.tr: n. 花店；花店店主；卖花人
words.ex: She bought roses from the florist.
words.ex_cn: 她从花店买了玫瑰。
words.en: A florist is a person who sells and arranges flowers.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.ex: I sympathize with people who are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 我同情那些挨饿的人。
words.en: If you sympathize with someone who is in a bad situation, you feel sorry for them.

words.tr:
n. 库存；股票；家畜；
v. 备有；贮存；
words.ex: The store has low stock of winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣库存很少。
words.en: The supply of goods available for sale in a store; the capital raised by a company through the issue of shares.

words.ex: The loan requires collateral documents.
words.ex_cn: 这笔贷款需要附属文件。
words.en: Collateral is something pledged as security for repayment of a loan, to be forfeited in the event of a default.

words.tr: n. 几率；不利条件；不平等；
words.ex: The odds of winning the lottery are very low.
words.ex_cn: 中彩票的几率非常低。
words.en: The odds are the chances that a particular thing will happen.

words.ex: The sign helped redirect the traffic away from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志帮助将车流改道，避开事故现场。
words.en: To direct something to a new or different place or purpose.

words.tr:
v. 打破；打断；
n. 休息；中断；破裂；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打破了玻璃。
words.en: If you break something, you cause it to separate into two or more pieces, often in a way that is irreparable.

words.ex: The investor gave money to the new business.
words.ex_cn: 这位投资者为这家新企业提供了资金。
words.en: An investor is a person or organization that puts money into financial schemes, property, etc. with the expectation of achieving a profit.

words.tr: adj. 繁荣的；旺盛的；兴旺的； v. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长；“thrive”的现在分词；
words.ex: The town is thriving because of its new factories.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇因为新的工厂而繁荣。
words.en: Prospering or flourishing; successful.

words.ex: He will repay the loan next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月会偿还贷款。
words.en: If you repay a loan or a debt, you pay back the money that you owe to the person who you borrowed or took it from.

words.ex: Honesty is important in friendship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实在友谊中很重要。
words.en: The quality of being honest, which involves being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit or fraud.

chapters.name: If you ask me Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 依我看；恕我直言；要我说的话（用于表达个人意见）
words.ex: If you ask me, we should leave now to avoid the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 依我看，我们应该现在离开以避免交通拥堵。
words.en: used to introduce your opinion or suggestion about something.

words.w: sth. is not all it's cracked up to be
words.tr: phrase. 某事物并不像人们所吹嘘的那样好；名不副实
words.uk: sʌmθɪŋ ɪz nɒt ɔːl ɪts krækt ʌp tuː biː
words.us: sʌmθɪŋ ɪz nɑːt ɔːl ɪts krækt ʌp tuː biː
words.ex: This movie is not all it's cracked up to be.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影并没有人们说的那么好。
words.en: something is not as good as it is claimed to be

words.tr: phrase. 完全正确地；准确无误地（表示某人所说的话或所做的判断非常准确）
words.ex: His prediction was bang on.
words.ex_cn: 他的预测非常准确。
words.en: If something is bang on, it is exactly right or exactly in the right place.

words.tr: phrase. 出乎意料地；突然地；晴天霹雳般地
words.ex: She called me out of the blue yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天突然给我打了电话。
words.en: If something happens out of the blue, it happens unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. 照这样的速度；照这样下去
words.ex: At this rate, we will finish the work tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 照这样下去，我们明天就能完成工作。
words.en: If you say that something is happening at a particular rate, you mean that it is continuing or developing at that speed.

words.ex: He can't even walk, let alone run.
words.ex_cn: 他连走都走不了，更别说跑了。
words.en: Used to emphasize the improbability of a contrasting example.

words.tr: 短语动词. 看中某物；留意某人或某事
words.uk: hæv sʌmˈbɒdi z aɪ ɒn ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: hæv ˈsʌmbədi z aɪ ɑn ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: She has her eye on that new car.
words.ex_cn: 她看中了那辆新车。
words.en: If you have your eye on something, you are interested in it or want to have it.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.tr: phrase. 屈服于不可避免的事；接受无法改变的现实
words.ex: Sometimes you have to bow to the inevitable and accept what you cannot change.
words.ex_cn: 有时候你必须向不可避免的事情低头，接受你无法改变的事实。
words.en: To accept something that cannot be avoided.

words.tr: phrase. 打包； 收拾；停止工作； 出故障
words.ex: He will pack up his clothes tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会收拾好他的衣服。
words.en: To put things into cases or boxes so that they can be transported or stored; to stop working or operating.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；告终；意外到达
words.ex: He didn't plan to stay, but he ended up sleeping there.
words.ex_cn: 他本没打算留下，但最后在那里睡了。
words.en: If you end up in a particular place or situation, you are in that place or situation after a series of events, even though you did not originally intend to be.

words.ex: The teacher called the students by name.
words.ex_cn: 老师按名字叫学生。
words.en: By name means to refer to someone or something using their name.

words.w: to cut a long story short
words.tr: 短语. 长话短说；简而言之
words.ex: To cut a long story short, we ended up getting lost and had to ask for directions.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，我们最终迷路了，不得不问路。
words.en: Used to say that you are only going to mention the main facts of something.

words.ex: This math problem is dead easy.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题太简单了。
words.en: If you say that something is dead easy, you are emphasizing that it is very easy to do.

words.tr: phrase. 请某人吃/喝某物；以某物款待某人
words.ex: He treated us to dinner at a fancy restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他请我们在一家高档餐厅吃了晚餐。
words.en: To pay for something for someone else as a special gift or treat.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.

words.tr: phrase. 相当好；颇为顺利；几乎；差不多
words.ex: She sings pretty well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得相当好。
words.en: To a considerable extent or degree; almost.

words.ex: I've pretty much finished the project.
words.ex_cn: 我几乎完成了这个项目。
words.en: Almost; nearly.

words.ex: He left early for fear that he would miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早离开，生怕赶不上公交车。
words.en: used to introduce the reason for an action, especially when the action is taken to avoid a particular situation or outcome

words.tr: phrase. 超出预期；超过期望值
words.ex: The student exceeded expectations on the test.
words.ex_cn: 这名学生在考试中超出了预期。
words.en: To go beyond what is expected or to surpass the anticipated level of performance or quality.

words.ex: The performance exceeded everyone's expectations.
words.ex_cn: 演出超出了所有人的预期。
words.en: To surpass what was anticipated by someone.

chapters.name: Résumés across cultures New words

words.ex: He bought a new accessory for his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的手机买了一个新配件。
words.en: An accessory is something such as a bag or piece of jewelry that you wear or carry because it is attractive.

words.ex: The navigator helped the ship find its way.
words.ex_cn: 领航员帮助船找到了航向。
words.en: A navigator is someone who is skilled in planning and directing the route of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments and maps.

words.ex: He gave a concise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了简明的回答。
words.en: Something that is concise says everything that is necessary without using any unnecessary words.

words.tr: adj. 教育的；有教育意义的；
words.ex: This is an educational video for children.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个为儿童制作的教育视频。
words.en: Educational means relating to education or the process of education.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: The two topics are unrelated.
words.ex_cn: 这两个话题没有关联。
words.en: If one thing is unrelated to another, there is no connection between them.

words.tr: v. 做得过分；使…过度；过多使用
words.ex: Don't overdo the sugar in your tea.
words.ex_cn: 别在茶里放太多糖。
words.en: To do something to an excessive degree; to exaggerate or overuse something.

words.ex: She embellished the dress with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 她用花朵装饰了这条裙子。
words.en: To embellish something means to make it more attractive by adding decorative details or features.

words.tr: v. 使协调一致；使和谐；配上和音
words.ex: The two singers try to harmonize their voices.
words.ex_cn: 两位歌手试图让他们的声音和谐。
words.en: If two or more things harmonize, they combine in a pleasing way, or if you harmonize them, you make them combine in a pleasing way.

words.tr: n. 欧洲通行证（一种欧洲联盟为促进劳动力自由流动而设计的标准化文件，包括简历、语言护照等）
words.ex: The Europass is a valuable tool for job seekers across Europe.
words.ex_cn: 欧洲通行证是全欧洲求职者的宝贵工具。
words.en: A standardized CV format used across Europe to facilitate the mobility of workers and students.

words.ex: She cheered enthusiastically for her team.
words.ex_cn: 她热情地为她的队伍加油。
words.en: If you do something enthusiastically, you do it with great eagerness and excitement.

words.ex: He works as a freelancer and designs websites.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名自由职业者，设计网站。
words.en: A freelancer is someone who is self-employed and is not committed to a particular employer long-term.

chapters.name: Danger! Books may change your life New words

words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.ex: She dreams of going to wonderland.
words.ex_cn: 她梦想去仙境。
words.en: A land or place full of wonderful things; a fairyland.

words.ex: The observer recorded the weather every day.
words.ex_cn: 观测者每天记录天气。
words.en: An observer is someone who sees or notices something, or who watches something carefully.

words.tr: adj. 令人不安的；令人慌张的；令人窘迫的； v. “disconcert”的现在分词；
words.ex: The loud noise was disconcerting.
words.ex_cn: 那阵响声令人不安。
words.en: If you say that something is disconcerting, you mean that it makes you feel anxious, confused, or embarrassed.

words.ex: His neglect of the project caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 他对项目的疏忽导致了延误。
words.en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the attention or care that they need.

words.ex: He normally goes to bed at 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他通常晚上10点睡觉。
words.en: If you say that something normally happens or that you normally do a particular thing, you mean that it is what usually happens or what you usually do.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.ex: He buys a novel at the bookshop.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A shop where books are sold.

words.ex: The hikers enjoyed a beautiful vista from the mountain top.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者们从山顶欣赏到了美丽的景色。
words.en: A vista is a pleasing view, especially one seen through a long, narrow opening.

words.ex: His wrath scared everyone in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他的愤怒吓到了房间里的每个人。
words.en: Extreme anger.

words.ex: He speaks a local dialect in his village.
words.ex_cn: 他在村子里说一种地方方言。
words.en: A dialect is a form of a language that is spoken in a particular area and that uses some of its own words, grammar, and pronunciations.

words.tr: v. 使着迷；使陶醉；对…施魔法
words.ex: The magic show enchants the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们着迷。
words.en: If you are enchanted by someone or something, they cause you to have feelings of great delight or pleasure.

words.ex: The rule excludes children under 12.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则排除了12岁以下的孩子。
words.en: To exclude someone or something means to prevent them from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.ex: She is supremely confident in her abilities.
words.ex_cn: 她对自己的能力极其自信。
words.en: To an extreme or utmost degree.

words.ex: He is an influential teacher in our school.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们学校一位有影响力的老师。
words.en: Having great influence on someone or something.

words.tr: n. 就寝时间；睡觉时间；
words.ex: His bedtime is 9 p.m. every night.
words.ex_cn: 他的就寝时间是每天晚上9点。
words.en: The time when someone usually goes to bed.

words.tr: n. 暗示；提示；有益的建议；
words.ex: He gave me a hint about the surprise party.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我关于惊喜派对的暗示。
words.en: A hint is a slight or indirect indication or suggestion.

words.tr: adj. 神秘的；神秘主义的
words.ex: The painting had a mystical quality that captivated viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种神秘的特质，令观众着迷。
words.en: If you describe something as mystical, you mean that it has spiritual qualities or that it involves spiritual powers and influences.

words.ex: The monk meditates every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位僧侣每天早上冥想。
words.en: A monk is a member of a religious community of men who live by certain vows and usually wear a habit.

words.ex: The priest said a prayer for the sick.
words.ex_cn: 牧师为病人祈祷。
words.en: A priest is a person who is qualified to perform religious duties and ceremonies in a Christian church.

words.ex: He cited a book in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在文章中引用了一本书。
words.en: To cite something means to quote it or mention it as evidence or proof of what you are saying.

words.ex: She wrote a poetic letter to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她给朋友写了一封诗意的信。
words.en: Something that is poetic is very beautiful and expresses emotions in a sensitive or moving way.

words.ex: The repetitive tasks seemed to be filled with meaninglessness.
words.ex_cn: 重复的任务似乎毫无意义。
words.en: The quality of having no meaning or purpose.

words.ex: He immersed the cloth in water.
words.ex_cn: 他把布浸在水里。
words.en: To immerse something or someone means to put them into a liquid so that they are completely covered by it. It can also mean to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.tr: n. 被动；不抵抗；消极状态
words.ex: His passivity made it hard to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的消极态度使解决问题变得困难。
words.en: The state or condition of being passive; lack of initiative or assertiveness.

words.ex: Parents should foster good habits in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该培养孩子的好习惯。
words.en: To foster something means to encourage and promote its development.

words.tr:
n. 硬币；金属钱币；
v. 创造；
words.ex: He has a coin in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有一枚硬币。
words.en: A coin is a small, flat, round piece of metal or plastic that is used as money.

words.tr: phrase. 本垒打（棒球术语）；指击球手击出后可跑完所有垒包并得分的一击；引申为一举成功或重大成功
words.ex: He hit a home run to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他打了一个全垒打赢得了比赛。
words.en: In baseball, a home run is a hit that allows the batter to make a complete circuit of the bases and score a run.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: She wore a diamond ring on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚钻石戒指。
words.en: A diamond is a precious stone consisting of a clear and colorless crystalline form of pure carbon, the hardest naturally occurring substance.

words.ex: The runner won the race quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位跑步者很快赢得了比赛。
words.en: A runner is a person who runs, especially in a race or as a sport.

words.ex: I like coffee, and she likes it likewise.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，她也喜欢。
words.en: You use likewise when you are comparing two methods, states, or situations and saying that they are similar.

words.ex: The ad induced him to buy the product.
words.ex_cn: 这则广告诱使他购买了该产品。
words.en: To induce a state or condition means to cause it.

words.ex: She tapped her fingers insistently on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她坚持不懈地用手指敲打着桌子。
words.en: If you say something insistently, you say it firmly and repeatedly, especially because you want to make your point clear.

words.tr: adv. 绝望地；拼命地；不顾一切地；极度地
words.ex: He is desperately trying to find his lost dog.
words.ex_cn: 他正在拼命寻找他丢失的狗。
words.en: In a way that shows a lack of hope and a willingness to do anything to change a situation, often involving a lot of effort or risk.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.ex: The cold water gave her a sudden sensation.
words.ex_cn: 冷水给了她一种突然的感觉。
words.en: A sensation is a physical feeling or a reaction of interest or excitement that something causes in a person or in a group of people.

words.ex: The bridge can withstand strong winds.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥能经受住强风。
words.en: If something or someone withstands a force or action, they survive it or do not give in to it.

chapters.name: Danger! Books may change your life Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 宁静；安静；平静（的环境）
words.ex: He wants peace and quiet after a long day.
words.ex_cn: 他经过漫长的一天后想要安静。
words.en: A state of tranquility or serenity, free from noise or disturbance.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有共同之处；有共同点
words.ex: They have something in common because they both enjoy hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他们有共同点，因为他们都喜欢徒步旅行。
words.en: To share similar interests, characteristics, or experiences with someone else.

words.w: have sth. in common with sb.
words.tr: 短语. 与某人在某方面有共同之处
words.uk: hæv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn ˈkɒmən wɪð ˈsʌmbədi
words.us: hæv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn ˈkɑːmən wɪð ˈsʌmbədi
words.ex: I have a lot in common with my brother.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥有很多共同点。
words.en: to share interests, experiences, or other characteristics with someone

words.tr: phrase. 不怕费事；特意花力气（做某事）
words.ex: He takes the trouble to help his classmates with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他不嫌麻烦地帮助同学做作业。
words.en: To make an effort to do something, especially when it is inconvenient or requires extra work.

words.w: take the trouble to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 不辞辛劳地做某事；特意费心做某事
words.ex: He took the trouble to drive me to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他不辞辛劳地开车送我去机场。
words.en: To make the effort to do something, especially when it is difficult or inconvenient.

words.ex: He seeks out new friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校里主动结交新朋友。
words.en: To seek out means to look for and find someone or something, especially when this is difficult or takes a lot of effort.

words.tr: phrase. 一口气地；一次性地；在（连续）一次坐着的时间内
words.ex: I read the entire novel in one sitting.
words.ex_cn: adv. 我一口气读完了整本小说。
words.en: To do something all at once, without stopping or taking a break.

chapters.name: They were alive and they spoke to me New words

words.tr: adj. 漂亮的；优秀的；相当多的
words.ex: He has goodly amount of patience.
words.ex_cn: 他有相当多的耐心。
words.en: Goodly is an adjective that describes something as considerable in size or extent, attractive, or of good quality.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.tr: v. 使士气低落；使失去斗志
words.ex: The bad news demoralized the team.
words.ex_cn: 这个坏消息使团队士气低落。
words.en: If something demoralizes someone, it makes them lose so much confidence in what they are doing that they want to give up.

words.ex: He made a confession about his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认了自己的错误。
words.en: A confession is a statement made by someone in which they admit that they have committed a particular crime or done something wrong.

words.ex: The company was accused of immorality in its business practices.
words.ex_cn: 该公司被指控在商业行为中存在不道德行为。
words.en: The quality or state of being immoral; wickedness.

words.ex: The smell of food whetted his appetite.
words.ex_cn: 食物的香味刺激了他的食欲。
words.en: To whet something means to make it sharper or more intense.

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.ex: The prohibition of smoking in public places improved air quality.
words.ex_cn: 在公共场所禁止吸烟改善了空气质量。
words.en: Prohibition is the act of forbidding something, especially by law.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: The mechanic checked the throttle on the car engine.
words.ex_cn: 机械师检查了汽车发动机的节流阀。
words.en: To throttle someone means to kill or injure them by squeezing their throat or tightening something around it and preventing them from breathing. A throttle is a device that controls the amount of fuel going into an engine.

words.ex: He acted on impulse and bought the car.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动买了那辆车。
words.en: An impulse is a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about the consequences.

words.tr: n. 厌恶世人者；遁世者
words.ex: He is a misanthrope who avoids people.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个避世的人，不喜欢与人交往。
words.en: A misanthrope is someone who dislikes and avoids other people.

words.ex: He strives to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力完成作业。
words.en: If you strive to do something or strive for something, you make a great effort to do it or get it.

words.tr:
v. 无所事事；闲荡
adj. 懈怠的；闲散的；不做事的
words.ex: He idles away the whole afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他整个下午都无所事事。
words.en: If you describe someone as idle, you mean they are not doing anything or they are not working hard.

words.ex: The soldiers loaded ammunition into their guns.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们把弹药装进枪里。
words.en: Ammunition refers to the projectiles and propelling charges used in guns, firearms, or any other weapons.

words.ex: The new job enriched his life.
words.ex_cn: 这份新工作使他的生活富裕起来。
words.en: To enrich something means to improve its quality, often by adding something to it.

words.tr: adj. 三倍的；三重的；有三部分的；
words.ex: The population has grown threefold in ten years.
words.ex_cn: 十年来，人口增长了三倍。
words.en: Three times as great or as numerous.

words.ex: Her irrepressible laugh filled the room.
words.ex_cn: 她抑制不住的笑声充满了房间。
words.en: If someone is irrepressible, they are full of energy and enthusiasm and cannot be controlled or stopped.

words.tr: adj. 无故的；无必要的；无偿的；免费的
words.ex: He made a gratuitous comment about her clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的衣服做了毫无必要的评论。
words.en: If you describe something as gratuitous, you mean that it is unnecessary, and often harmful or upsetting.

words.ex: The heavy rain drowned the small village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨淹没了这个小村庄。
words.en: To die by being underwater too long and unable to breathe, or to kill someone in this way.

words.ex: He secretly ate the last cookie.
words.ex_cn: 他偷偷吃了最后一块饼干。
words.en: In a way that is kept hidden from knowledge or view; not openly.

words.tr: v. 趟水；涉水；艰苦地进行
words.ex: He wades through the shallow river.
words.ex_cn: 他涉水走过浅河。
words.en: To walk through water or another liquid or soft substance that impedes movement.

words.ex: It is advantageous to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 早起是有利的。
words.en: If something is advantageous to you, it is likely to benefit you.

words.tr: adv. 轻率地；冒失地；仓促地
words.ex: He rashly quit his job without a plan.
words.ex_cn: 他鲁莽地辞了工作，却没有计划。
words.en: If someone acts rashly, they act hastily and without thinking carefully about what they are doing.

words.ex: He worked intensely to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他强烈地工作以完成这个项目。
words.en: If something is intense, it is very great or extreme in strength or degree.

words.ex: He is earnestly trying to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他正在认真地学习英语。
words.en: In a serious and sincere manner.

words.ex: He will forego dessert to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 为了保持健康，他将放弃甜点。
words.en: To forego something means to decide not to have or do something that you would like to have or do.

words.ex: The book brought him great enlightenment.
words.ex_cn: 这本书给了他极大的启迪。
words.en: Enlightenment is the act of enlightening or the state of being enlightened. It can refer to the acquisition of spiritual knowledge or understanding, especially in Buddhism.

words.ex: He has business acumen and makes smart decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他有商业洞察力，能做出明智的决定。
words.en: The ability to make good judgments and quick decisions, typically in a particular domain.

words.ex: He will tackle the problem tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会处理这个问题。
words.en: If you tackle a problem or task, you deal with it in a determined way. In sports such as football and rugby, a tackle is an act of trying to take the ball from a player on the other team.

words.ex: His stature in the scientific community is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学界声望很高。
words.en: The height of a person or an animal in a standing position; the level of respect that people have for a person or organization because of their importance or success.

words.tr: adv. 明确无疑地；毋庸置疑地
words.ex: His success was indubitably due to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功无疑是因为他的努力工作。
words.en: Without doubt; certainly.

words.ex: His painting shows great originality.
words.ex_cn: 他的画作展现了极大的独创性。
words.en: The quality of being new and original in a way that is not derived from something else.

words.ex: The farm has a big storehouse for grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场有一个存放谷物的大仓库。
words.en: A storehouse is a building where things are stored.

words.ex: He wrote an autobiographical book about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一本关于自己童年的自传体书籍。
words.en: Relating to or in the style of an autobiography.

words.ex: The job is repetitive and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作重复且无聊。
words.en: Something that is repetitive involves doing the same thing over and over again.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.tr: adj. 惊人的；巨大的；奇异的；巨大的；
words.ex: He showed a prodigious memory for names.
words.ex_cn: 他对名字有着惊人的记忆力。
words.en: If you describe something as prodigious, you are emphasizing that it is very large or impressive.

words.ex: Her talent is unparalleled.
words.ex_cn: 她的才华是无比的。
words.en: Having no parallel or equal; unmatched.

words.ex: This book is widely used in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: In a way that extends over a large area or range; extensively.

words.tr: adv. 庄严地；像国王似地
words.ex: He was royally ignored by the staff.
words.ex_cn: 他被工作人员完全无视了。
words.en: In a manner befitting a king or queen; splendidly or magnificently.

chapters.name: They were alive and they spoke to me Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；在大多数情况下
words.ex: For the most part, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 大多数时候，他走路去学校。
words.en: You use for the most part to indicate that something is generally true or mostly happens in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 渴望做某事；非常想做某事
words.ex: She longed to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 她渴望环游世界。
words.en: To have a strong desire or wish to do something.

words.ex: People look upon him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 人们把他看作英雄。
words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a particular way.

words.ex: I like the movie, mind you, it's a bit slow.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢这部电影，你要知道，它有点慢。
words.en: Used to introduce a statement that qualifies or contrasts with a previous statement.

words.ex: I cannot part with my old watch.
words.ex_cn: 我无法放弃我的旧手表。
words.en: To give up possession or association with something or someone, often reluctantly.

words.tr: phrase. 玩弄；不认真考虑；漫不经心地对待
words.ex: He likes to toy with small ideas before making big decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他在做重大决定之前喜欢随意考虑一些小想法。
words.en: To consider something casually or without serious intent; to play or fiddle with something idly.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然发现；意外碰见
words.ex: I stumble upon a small shop when I walk in the street.
words.ex_cn: 我在街上走时偶然发现了一家小商店。
words.en: If you stumble upon something or someone, you discover them unexpectedly or by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 作为兼职；另外；暗地里
words.ex: He works as a teacher and drives a taxi on the side.
words.ex_cn: 他当老师，同时兼职开出租车。
words.en: If someone does something on the side, they do it in addition to their main job.

words.tr: phrase. 可以说；在某种程度上
words.ex: He was, as it were, a walking encyclopedia.
words.ex_cn: 他可以说是活生生的百科全书。
words.en: Used to indicate that a word or statement is perhaps not exact though practically right.

chapters.name: Things Fall Apart New words

words.ex: The tribe lives in the forest and follows old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在森林里，遵循古老的传统。
words.en: A tribe is a social division in a traditional society consisting of families or communities linked by social, economic, religious, or blood ties, with a common culture and dialect, typically having a recognized leader.

words.ex: The missionary taught children in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 这位传教士在一个小村庄里教孩子们。
words.en: A missionary is a person who is sent to a foreign country to spread a religion.

words.ex: The warrior fought bravely to protect his village.
words.ex_cn: 这位战士勇敢地战斗以保护他的村庄。
words.en: A warrior is a person who is engaged in or experienced in battle, or who shows or has shown great vigor, courage, or aggressiveness, as in politics or athletics.

words.tr:
n. 解开；祸根；毁灭的原因
v. 解开；撤消；毁掉；“undo”的现在分词
words.ex: The undoing of the knot took only a few seconds.
words.ex_cn: 解开这个结只花了几秒钟。
words.en: The act of causing someone's failure or ruin.

words.tr:
v. 牺牲；
n. 牺牲（品）；
words.ex: He sacrificed his time to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.ex: The tribespeople lived in harmony with nature.
words.ex_cn: 部落成员与自然和谐共处。
words.en: Tribespeople are the members of a tribe, especially those living in a traditional way.

words.ex: He believes in Christianity and goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他信仰基督教，每周日都去教堂。
words.en: Christianity is a monotheistic religion based on the life and teachings of Jesus Christ as presented in the New Testament.

words.tr: adj. 充满热情的；热心的；
words.ex: He is enthusiastic about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他对打篮球充满热情。
words.en: If you are enthusiastic about something, you show how much you like or enjoy it by the way that you behave and talk.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.tr: n. （违法犯罪团伙的）头目，首恶，元凶
words.ex: The police arrested the ringleader of the gang.
words.ex_cn: 警方逮捕了该团伙的头目。
words.en: A ringleader is the person who leads or organizes a group, especially in doing something illegal or wrong.

words.ex: The wind blew bitterly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风刺骨地吹过树林。
words.en: In a way that is filled with or marked by strong negative emotions such as anger, sorrow, or disappointment.

words.ex: The administrator fixed the computer system.
words.ex_cn: 管理人员修复了计算机系统。
words.en: An administrator is a person whose job involves helping to organize and supervise the way that an organization or institution functions.

words.tr: n. 和解；平定；讲和；绥靖
words.ex: The government tried pacification after the riots.
words.ex_cn: 政府在骚乱后尝试了安抚。
words.en: The act of bringing peace to a place or ending war or violence.

words.tr: adj. 老一套的；刻板的；带有成见的
words.ex: He wears stereotypical clothes for his job.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着符合刻板印象的职业服装。
words.en: A stereotypical idea of a type of person or thing is a fixed general idea that a lot of people have about it, which may be untrue in many cases.

words.tr: n. 描绘；描述；描写；展现方式；
words.ex: The movie's portrayal of love is very touching.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对爱情的描绘非常感人。
words.en: A portrayal of someone or something is a description or depiction of them in a particular way.

words.tr: n. 殖民者；殖民地开拓者；移民
words.ex: The colonizer took land from the native people.
words.ex_cn: 殖民者从原住民手中夺取了土地。
words.en: A colonizer is a person who settles in and establishes control over a foreign country or area.

chapters.name: Been there, done that, got the T-shirt New words

words.ex: The invasion of privacy is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 侵犯隐私是一个严重的问题。
words.en: An invasion is an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.

words.tr:
n. （军队的）团；大群；大量
v. 把...编组；严格管制
words.ex: He joined the army and was in a regiment.
words.ex_cn: 他参军了，被编入一个团。
words.en: A regiment is a large group of soldiers that is commanded by a colonel.

words.ex: The police investigated the assault on the old man.
words.ex_cn: 警方调查了对那位老人的攻击。
words.en: An assault is a physical attack on someone, or a military attack on a place.

words.ex: He makes occasional visits to his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望祖父母。
words.en: Occasional means happening or done sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.ex: The soldiers ran through the gunfire to reach safety.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们穿过炮火到达安全地带。
words.en: Gunfire is the repeated shooting of guns.

words.tr:
v. 避开；躲避
n. 躲避；诡计
words.ex: He dodged the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速躲开了球。
words.en: If you dodge, you move quickly, often to avoid being hit, caught, or seen.

words.ex: The accident caused many casualties.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故造成了许多伤亡人员。
words.en: A casualty is a person who is killed or injured in a war or in an accident.

words.ex: His knowledge of history is superficial.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史的了解是表面的。
words.en: If you describe someone as superficial, you disapprove of them because they do not think deeply, and have little understanding of anything serious or important.

words.ex: The cows graze in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛每天早上在田野里吃草。
words.en: To graze means to feed on grass or to touch something lightly in passing.

words.ex: The cactus has fleshy stems to store water.
words.ex_cn: 仙人掌有肉质的茎来储存水分。
words.en: If you describe something as fleshy, you mean that it is thick and soft, like flesh.

words.ex: The movie was fairly interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影相当地有趣。
words.en: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree.

words.tr: adj. 机智的；圆滑的；得体的
words.ex: He was tactful when he said no to her request.
words.ex_cn: 当他拒绝她的请求时，他很得体。
words.en: If you describe someone as tactful, you approve of them because they are careful not to say or do anything that would offend or upset other people.

words.tr:
n. 凡人
adj. 致命的；终有一死的
words.ex: All mortal beings must die someday.
words.ex_cn: 所有凡人都终有一死。
words.en: If you refer to the fact that people are mortal, you mean that they have to die and cannot live forever.

words.ex: The cave paintings are prehistoric.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画是史前的。
words.en: Belonging to or existing in times before recorded history.

words.tr: adj. 功能的；起作用的；实用的；
words.ex: This chair is functional and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子功能性强且舒适。
words.en: Relating to the way in which something works or operates.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.ex: His modesty made everyone like him.
words.ex_cn: 他的谦虚让所有人都喜欢他。
words.en: Modesty is the quality of not being too proud or confident about yourself or your abilities.

words.tr: adj. 免费力的；维护成本低的
words.ex: She prefers a low-maintenance hairstyle.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢易于打理的发型。
words.en: Requiring little care or effort to keep in good condition.

words.tr:
adj. 斯堪的纳维亚（人）的；
n. 斯堪的纳维亚人（语）；
words.ex: He enjoys Scandinavian music and cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢斯堪的纳维亚音乐和寒冷的天气。
words.en: Relating to Scandinavia, its people, or their languages.

words.ex: His silence implies he disagrees.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他不同意。
words.en: To suggest or indicate something indirectly rather than stating it explicitly.

words.ex: He uses this park exclusively for walking.
words.ex_cn: 他只在这个公园散步。
words.en: If you do something exclusively, you do it only in the way mentioned, and not in any other way.

words.ex: She is a well-known fashionista who always stays ahead of the trends.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个著名的时尚达人，总是走在潮流的前沿。
words.en: A fashionista is someone who is very interested in and knowledgeable about fashion, and who always dresses in the latest styles.

words.tr: n. 追随者；拥护者；信徒；
words.ex: He is a loyal follower of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 他是这位艺术家的忠实追随者。
words.en: A follower is a person who supports and admires a particular person or set of ideas.

words.ex: The concert was fabulous!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something as fabulous, you are emphasizing that you like it a lot or think that it is very good.

words.ex: The practicality of this tool makes it popular among workers.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的实用性使它在工人中很受欢迎。
words.en: The quality of being suitable for a particular purpose or situation; the ability to be put to practical use.

words.tr: n. 测量仪器；规格；评估；
words.ex: The mechanic used a gauge to check the tire pressure.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用一个测量仪器来检查轮胎气压。
words.en: A gauge is a device that measures the amount or quantity of something and shows the measurement in a form that is easy to read, such as a dial or a digital display.

words.tr:
v. 建筑；建造；逐步加强；
n. 体格；体形；
words.ex: They build a house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他们在湖边建了一所房子。
words.en: To construct something by putting parts or material together.

words.tr: adj. 精美的；细腻的；强烈的
words.ex: She wore an exquisite dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精美的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is exquisite is extremely beautiful or pleasant, especially in a delicate or refined way.

words.ex: The weather can dictate what we wear each day.
words.ex_cn: 天气可以支配我们每天穿什么。
words.en: To dictate means to say or read something aloud for someone else to write down, or to give orders in an authoritative manner.

words.ex: He bought an extravagant car that cost too much money.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆奢侈的车，价格太贵了。
words.en: Spending much more than is necessary or wise; excessively expensive.

words.tr: adj. 自私的；固执己见的；过于专注自身利益的
words.ex: He is self-absorbed and never listens to others.
words.ex_cn: 他很自私，从不听别人说话。
words.en: Someone who is self-absorbed thinks so much about themselves and their own interests that they do not notice other people or their problems.

words.ex: Wearing shorts to the meeting is inappropriate.
words.ex_cn: 穿短裤去参加会议是不合适的。
words.en: If you say that something is inappropriate, you are criticizing it because you think it is not suitable for a particular situation or purpose.

words.ex: He was late, so he left accordingly.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，于是相应地提前出发了。
words.en: In a way that is appropriate to the particular circumstances.

words.ex: The weather is favourable for a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气对野餐有利。
words.en: If your opinion or your reaction is favourable to something, you agree with it and approve of it.

words.ex: She ate a crisp apple for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个脆苹果当点心。
words.en: Something that is crisp is hard, and makes a pleasant sound when you break it or crush it.

words.ex: The lock uses a simple combination of three numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁使用三个数字的简单组合。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of things or people that are combined.

words.tr: adj. 忧郁的；阴沉的；阴暗的
words.ex: The room was sombre after the light went out.
words.ex_cn: 灯灭后，房间变得阴暗。
words.en: If someone is sombre, they are serious or sad. If a place or event is sombre, it is dark and gloomy.

words.ex: The soldier wore camouflage to hide in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 士兵穿着伪装服在森林中隐藏自己。
words.en: Camouflage is the way in which some animals are colored and shaped so that they cannot easily be seen in their natural surroundings.

words.tr:
n. 伪装；伪装物；
v. 伪装；掩饰；
words.ex: He wore a hat and glasses as a disguise.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了帽子和眼镜作为伪装。
words.en: To disguise means to change your appearance or behavior so that people will not recognize you, or to make something seem different from what it really is.

words.tr: adj. 惊恐的；恶臭的；时髦的；放克风格的
words.ex: The children felt funky when they heard the loud thunder.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们听到巨大的雷声时感到惊恐。
words.en: Having a strong dance rhythm, in particular that of funk. Also, stylish in an unconventional or quirky way.

words.tr: adj. 有效率的；认真的；有条理的
words.ex: She gave a businesslike reply to the question.
words.ex_cn: 她对这个问题给出了一个高效的回答。
words.en: If you describe someone's approach as businesslike, you mean that they deal with things in an efficient way without wasting time.

words.ex: She bought a new outfit for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一套新衣服。
words.en: An outfit is a set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.tr:
n. 青少年；
adj. 青少年的；
words.ex: The adolescent walked to school with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年和朋友们一起走路去上学。
words.en: An adolescent is a young person who is developing into an adult.

words.ex: He gave her a romantic gift on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节送了她一份浪漫的礼物。
words.en: If you describe something as romantic, you mean that it is connected with love or with a feeling of excitement and mystery associated with love.

words.tr:
n. 母亲身份；
adj. 产妇的；
words.ex: She enjoys her maternity after giving birth to her first child.
words.ex_cn: 她在生下第一个孩子后享受做母亲的身份。
words.en: Maternity refers to the state of being a mother or the period during which a woman is pregnant or has recently given birth.

words.ex: She is happy about her pregnancy.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的妊娠感到开心。
words.en: The condition of having a developing embryo or fetus in the body, especially in the uterus.

words.tr: adj. 可疑的；怀疑的；拿不准的；
words.ex: The deal seemed dubious to me.
words.ex_cn: 这个交易在我看来很可疑。
words.en: If you describe something as dubious, you mean that you do not consider it to be completely honest, safe, or reliable.

words.ex: She wears a gold necklace every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都戴一条金项链。
words.en: A necklace is a piece of jewellery such as a chain or a string of beads which someone, usually a woman, wears around their neck.

words.ex: She wore a multi-coloured dress that caught everyone's attention.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件多色的连衣裙，吸引了所有人的注意。
words.en: Having many colours.

words.ex: He wears a pair of sneakers to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一双运动鞋去学校。
words.en: A sneaker is a type of soft shoe that you wear for sports or as informal wear.

words.tr: n. 路由；路径选择；（材料或产品的）加工路线安排
words.ex: The router uses routing to send data to the right place.
words.ex_cn: 路由器使用路由将数据发送到正确的地方。
words.en: Routing refers to the process of selecting paths in a network along which to send network traffic, or the act of directing or sending something along a particular path.

words.ex: Smartphones are ubiquitous in modern life.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机在现代生活中无处不在。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as ubiquitous, you mean that they seem to be everywhere.

words.ex: The map has an indicative arrow to show the way.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图上有一个指示方向的箭头。
words.en: If one thing is indicative of another, it suggests what the other thing is likely to be.

words.tr: adj. 矫正性的，惩戒性的，精练的 v. 惩戒; 惩罚（某人）（使之改正或改进）( chasten
words.ex: The experience was a chastening one, teaching him valuable lessons.
words.ex_cn: 这次经历是一次惩戒性的经历，教会了他宝贵的教训。
words.en: Serving or intended to chastise or correct; corrective.

chapters.name: Been there, done that, got the T-shirt Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 不妨；倒不如；还是…为好
words.ex: Since we're already here, we might as well stay for the show.
words.ex_cn: 既然我们已经在这里了，不妨留下来看表演。
words.en: Used to suggest that something should be done or accepted because there is no good reason not to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 倒不如；还是…的好；不妨；可以
words.ex: You might just as well stay at home if you don't want to go out.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不想出去，还是呆在家里好。
words.en: If you say that you might just as well do something, you mean that you would do it with the same effect as another action you are considering.

words.tr: phrase. 以牺牲某事物为代价
words.ex: He succeeded at the expense of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但以牺牲健康为代价。
words.en: If something is done at the expense of someone or something else, it is achieved by harming them or by using their resources.

words.ex: He decided to run the risk of losing everything.
words.ex_cn: 他决定冒险失去一切。
words.en: To expose oneself to the possibility of something bad happening.

words.tr: phrase. 冒…的风险；有…的危险
words.ex: He was willing to run the risk of losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意冒失去工作的风险。
words.en: To be in a situation where there is a possibility of something bad happening.

words.ex: He dressed down for the weekend party.
words.ex_cn: 他为了周末的聚会穿得随便些。
words.en: To wear clothes that are less formal than usual; to reprimand someone severely.

words.tr: phrase. 一种庄重或特殊场合的感觉；对重要时刻的意识
words.ex: She always dresses with a sense of occasion, no matter the event.
words.ex_cn: 无论什么场合，她总是穿着得体，很有场合意识。
words.en: A feeling or understanding that a particular event or situation is important and should be marked in some special way.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 起起落落；高潮与低谷；人生的顺境与逆境
words.ex: Life is full of highs and lows.
words.ex_cn: 生活充满了高潮和低谷。
words.en: The varying experiences of success and failure, happiness and sadness, etc., that occur in a person's life.

chapters.name: Eco-jewellery: sea glass New words

words.ex: She wore beautiful jewellery to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了漂亮的珠宝去参加派对。
words.en: Jewellery consists of objects that are worn for personal adornment, such as bracelets, rings, necklaces, and earrings, often made from precious metals and gemstones.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.tr: adj. 难以捉摸的；不易被抓获（觉察、理解或记忆）的；
words.ex: The truth remained elusive.
words.ex_cn: 真相难以捉摸。
words.en: Difficult to find, catch, or achieve; difficult to remember or understand.

words.ex: She scoured the pan until it was clean.
words.ex_cn: 她把锅擦得干干净净。
words.en: If you scour something, you clean it by rubbing it hard with something rough.

words.tr: v. 侧向移动；悄悄贴近
words.ex: She sidled up to him and whispered in his ear.
words.ex_cn: 她侧身悄悄靠近他，在他耳边低语。
words.en: To move sideways or obliquely, especially in a stealthy or furtive manner.

words.tr:
v. 跌倒；摔倒；暴跌
n. 摔倒；混乱；暴跌
words.ex: The child tumble down the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 孩子从楼梯上跌倒了。
words.en: If someone or something tumbles, they fall quickly and suddenly, often turning over or spinning as they fall.

words.tr: adv. 如魔法般地；用魔法地
words.ex: The wand magically turned the frog into a prince.
words.ex_cn: 魔杖神奇地把青蛙变成了王子。
words.en: In a manner that is so beautiful, pleasant, or good that it seems to be not real or to be produced by magic.

words.ex: The luminous moon lights up the night.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的月亮照亮了夜晚。
words.en: Something that is luminous shines or glows in the dark.

words.tr:
n. (从事某项活动的)规定期限
v. 吝惜；节省
words.ex: He did a short stint as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他短暂地当过一段时间老师。
words.en: A stint is a fixed period of time during which someone does a particular job or activity.

words.ex: He ate a chunk of cheese for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一大块奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large piece or amount of it.

words.ex: He was officially appointed as the new manager.
words.ex_cn: 他被正式任命为新经理。
words.en: In a formal or authoritative manner; according to the rules or laws.

words.ex: She wore a red gem on her necklace.
words.ex_cn: 她脖子上戴着一颗红宝石。
words.en: A gem is a jewel or stone that is used in jewellery.

words.ex: She wore a necklace made of amber.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一条琥珀制成的项链。
words.en: Amber is a hard, translucent, yellowish-brown substance that is used for making jewelry or other objects. It is formed from the resin of ancient trees.

words.tr: n. 平底玻璃杯；一杯量；翻筋斗杂技演员
words.ex: He drank water from a tumbler.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个平底玻璃杯喝水。
words.en: A tumbler is a drinking glass with straight sides and no handle or stem.

words.ex: She threaded a bead onto the string.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗有孔的小珠穿在绳子上。
words.en: A bead is a small piece of glass, wood, or plastic that is used for decorating clothes or making jewellery.

words.ex: The needle will pierce the skin.
words.ex_cn: 针会刺穿皮肤。
words.en: If a sharp object pierces something, or if you pierce something with a sharp object, the object goes into it and makes a hole in it.

words.tr: n. 微丝，微纤丝（细胞骨架系统成分之一）
words.ex: Microfilaments are crucial components of the cytoskeleton.
words.ex_cn: 微丝是细胞骨架的关键组成部分。
words.en: A microfilament is a thin, thread-like protein structure found in cells, involved in cell movement and shape maintenance.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: She wore a beautiful anklet with her sandals.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着凉鞋时戴了一条漂亮的脚链。
words.en: An anklet is a piece of jewelry that is worn around the ankle.

words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.tr: n. 珠宝商；钟表匠；宝石匠；珠宝店
words.ex: The jeweller fixed her broken necklace.
words.ex_cn: 珠宝商修好了她断裂的项链。
words.en: A jeweller is a person who makes, sells, or repairs jewellery and watches.

words.tr: n. 木瓦；墙面板；鹅卵石；海滨砂石；招牌
words.ex: The roof is covered with brown shingles.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶铺着棕色的木瓦。
words.en: Shingles are thin, flat pieces of wood or other material that are laid in overlapping rows to cover the roof of a building.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.tr: v. 主持；指挥；担任会议主席
words.ex: He presides over the meeting every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一主持会议。
words.en: To preside means to be in charge of a formal meeting, ceremony, or other event.

words.tr: adj. 极好的；令人震惊的； v. “stun”的现在分词；
words.ex: She wore a stunning dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件极好的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Extremely impressive or attractive.

words.ex: The boys went afield to hunt birds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们离家远去打猎。
words.en: If you go afield, you go a long way from home or from your usual surroundings.

words.ex: He is a collector of old coins.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位古钱币收藏家。
words.en: A collector is a person who collects things of a particular type as a hobby or for investment.

words.ex: He lives in a small county in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村的一个小郡里。
words.en: A county is a region of a country used for administrative or other purposes in certain modern nations.

words.ex: The truck carries one tonne of coal.
words.ex_cn: 这辆卡车载着一吨煤。
words.en: A tonne is a unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms.

words.ex: His folly led to the loss of his job.
words.ex_cn: 他的愚蠢导致他丢了工作。
words.en: If you say that a particular action or way of behaving is folly, you mean that it is foolish.

words.ex: His negligence caused the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他的疏忽导致了事故。
words.en: Negligence is failure to take proper care over something that you are responsible for, which might cause damage or loss.

words.ex: The disposal of waste is important for the environment.
words.ex_cn: 废物的处理对环境很重要。
words.en: The act or process of getting rid of something, especially by throwing it away or selling it.

words.ex: The new software vastly improves speed.
words.ex_cn: 新软件极大地提高了速度。
words.en: To a very great extent or degree.

words.ex: He showed his credentials to get the job.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了资历来获得这份工作。
words.en: Credentials are documents that prove your identity or qualifications.

words.ex: The river water looked murky after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后，河水看起来污浊。
words.en: If you describe something as murky, you mean that the details of it are not clear or that it is difficult to understand.

words.ex: The extraction of coal harms the environment.
words.ex_cn: 煤炭的开采对环境有害。
words.en: The process of removing or obtaining something from something else.

words.ex: The medicine helped revive the sick man.
words.ex_cn: 这剂药帮助这位病人恢复了生机。
words.en: To revive something means to bring it back to life, consciousness, or use, or to make it active or successful again.

words.ex: He dumped the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾倒进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To dump something means to get rid of it quickly and without care, often because it is no longer wanted or needed. It can also refer to the place where waste is left.

words.ex: The teacher will not condone cheating in exams.
words.ex_cn: 老师不会容忍考试作弊。
words.en: To condone something means to accept or allow behavior that is considered wrong.

words.tr: v. 扔；抛；丢掷；放弃；离职
words.ex: He chucked the old book into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把那本旧书扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To throw something carelessly or casually; to give up or stop doing something.

words.tr:
v. 猛扑；突袭；抓住
n. 猛扑
words.ex: The cat will pounce on the mouse.
words.ex_cn: 猫会扑向老鼠。
words.en: If someone pounces on you, they come up towards you suddenly and take hold of you.

words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.ex: The tide comes in every twelve hours.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每十二小时涨一次。
words.en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

words.ex: He picked up a small pebble from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了一颗小石子。
words.en: A pebble is a small, smooth, round stone, especially one found on a beach or in a river.

chapters.name: Eco-jewellery: sea glass Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 严格的；不可更改的；死板的
words.ex: There are no hard and fast rules in this game.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏没有一成不变的规则。
words.en: A hard and fast rule or principle is one that is fixed and cannot be changed.

words.ex: The wind wears away the rock slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢地磨损了石头。
words.en: To erode or diminish gradually through friction, use, or exposure.

words.tr: phrase. v. 偶然发现；意外遇到
words.ex: I chanced upon an old photo while cleaning my closet.
words.ex_cn: 我在整理衣柜时偶然发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: To find or encounter something or someone by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.ex: The story revolves around a boy who finds a magic stone.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事围绕一个发现魔法石的男孩展开。
words.en: To revolve around something means to have it as the main subject or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 察觉到某事；对某事心中有数（常用于非正式语境）
words.ex: She is wise to the ways of the world.
words.ex_cn: 她对世事了如指掌。
words.en: Having knowledge or awareness of something, especially something that is not obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 正中某人下怀；干出对某人有利却对自己不利的事
words.ex: By refusing to compromise, he played into his opponent's hands.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝妥协，正中对手下怀。
words.en: To do something that gives someone else an advantage, often unintentionally.

words.tr: phrase. 洗餐具；洗脸和手；将...冲上岸；结束；毁掉
words.ex: He washes up after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他饭后洗碗。
words.en: To clean the dishes, cutlery, and other utensils used in preparing and eating a meal; to clean one's hands and face.

chapters.name: Tied up in knots New words

words.ex: He tied a knot in the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他在绳子上打了一个结。
words.en: A knot is a fastening made by tying a piece of string, rope, or something similar. It can also refer to a hard mass formed in a tree trunk at the intersection with a branch, or a unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour, used especially by ships and aircraft.

words.ex: He wears a red cravat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴一条红色领结去参加派对。
words.en: A cravat is a piece of folded cloth which a man wears wrapped around his neck.

words.tr:
adj. 克罗地亚的；克罗地亚人的；克罗地亚语的
n. 克罗地亚人；克罗地亚语
words.ex: He speaks Croatian fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地说克罗地亚语。
words.en: Relating to Croatia, its people, or their language.

words.ex: He put on a blue necktie for the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他为面试戴了一条蓝色领带。
words.en: A necktie is a long piece of cloth that is worn around the neck, usually by men, and is tied in a knot at the front. Neckties are often worn as part of formal or business attire.

words.tr: adj. 翻下的，翻折的 n. 低落; 拒绝; 谢绝; 可翻下部分
words.ex: He wore a shirt with a turndown collar.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件翻领衬衫。
words.en: A refusal or rejection of an offer, proposal, or request.

words.ex: The wearer of the helmet is safe.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔的人是安全的。
words.en: A wearer is someone who wears a particular type of clothing or accessory.

words.ex: He wears long hair and is a hippy.
words.ex_cn: 他留着长发，是个嬉皮士。
words.en: A hippy is someone who rejects the established culture and advocates extreme liberalism in society and politics, especially in the 1960s.

words.ex: The width of the table is one meter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的宽度是一米。
words.en: The width of something is the distance it measures from one side to the other.

words.ex: The newspaper's headline said 'City Wins Championship'.
words.ex_cn: 报纸的大字标题写着‘城市赢得冠军’。
words.en: A headline is the title of a newspaper story, printed in large letters at the top of the story, especially on the front page.

chapters.name: The credit card trap New words

words.tr:
adj. 满足的
v. 使满足；“content”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He felt contented after a simple meal with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人吃了一顿简单的饭后感到满足。
words.en: If you are contented, you are satisfied with your life or the situation you are in.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.tr: adv. 顺利地；平稳地；顺畅地；
words.ex: The machine works smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运行顺利。
words.en: In a smooth manner; without problems or difficulties.

words.ex: The refugees lived in abject poverty.
words.ex_cn: 这些难民过着凄惨的贫困生活。
words.en: Abject means extremely bad, unpleasant, and degrading.

words.tr: adj. 可怜的；悲哀的；差劲的；令人生厌的
words.ex: The little dog looked pathetic in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那只小狗在雨中看起来很可怜。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as pathetic, you mean that they are sad and weak or inadequate, and you feel contempt or pity for them.

words.ex: This brand has an exclusive design.
words.ex_cn: 这个品牌拥有独有的设计。
words.en: Something that is exclusive is available only to particular people, and not to everyone.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.ex: Technically, the phone works, but it's slow.
words.ex_cn: 技术上讲，这部手机能用，但很慢。
words.en: In a way that relates to the knowledge, machines, or methods used in science and industry.

words.tr: phrase. 客户信贷分类；信用等级
words.ex: The bank checked his credit rating before giving him a loan.
words.ex_cn: 银行在给他贷款前查看了他的客户信贷分类。
words.en: A credit rating is an evaluation of the credit risk of a prospective debtor (an individual, a business, company or a government), predicting their ability to pay back the debt, and an implicit forecast of the likelihood of the debtor defaulting.

words.ex: Water is indispensable for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必不可少的。
words.en: Absolutely necessary or essential.

words.tr: adj. 值得拥有的；令人渴望的；称心如意的；
words.ex: A quiet neighborhood is desirable for families.
words.ex_cn: 安静的社区对家庭来说是值得拥有的。
words.en: Something that is desirable is worth having or doing because it is useful, necessary, or popular.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.tr: adj. 光亮的；闪耀的；锃亮的；有光泽的；
words.ex: The shiny coin caught her eye.
words.ex_cn: 那枚光亮的硬币引起了她的注意。
words.en: Something that is shiny has a bright, smooth surface that reflects light.

words.ex: He is potentially going to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他有可能赢得比赛。
words.en: in a way that is possible or likely to happen or be true

words.tr:
n. 风险；
v. 冒...的危险；
words.ex: He took a risk by starting his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他创业时承担了风险。
words.en: If there is a risk of something unpleasant, there is a possibility that it will happen.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr:
v. 吸引；诱惑；引诱
n. 诱惑；诱饵；吸引力
words.ex: The bright colors lure the birds to the feeder.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引鸟类来到喂食器。
words.en: If you lure someone, you tempt them to do something or to go somewhere, especially by offering some form of reward.

words.tr: adj. 穷困的；赤穷的；贫瘠的； v. “impoverish”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The impoverished family lived in a small house with no heating.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫困的家庭住在一个没有暖气的小房子里。
words.en: An impoverished person or area is very poor.

words.tr: adj. 不切实际的；不实事求是的；
words.ex: It's unrealistic to expect to get rich quickly.
words.ex_cn: 指望快速致富是不切实际的。
words.en: If you say that someone is being unrealistic, you mean that they do not recognize the truth about a situation, especially about the difficulties involved in something they want to achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 慈善商店；义卖商店（出售捐赠物品以筹集善款的商店）
words.ex: I found a great book at the charity shop.
