words.en: If something such as a sound or event is resounding, it is very great or intense.

words.ex: He felt indignant when they blamed him for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 当他们把错误归咎于他时，他感到愤愤不平。
words.en: If you are indignant, you are shocked and angry, because you think that something is unjust or unfair.

words.tr: v. 发慈悲；动怜悯心；缓和
words.ex: The teacher finally relented and gave the students more time.
words.ex_cn: 老师终于发慈悲，给了学生们更多时间。
words.en: If you relent, you allow someone to do something that you had previously refused to allow them to do.

words.tr: adj. 衰弱的；衰败的；软弱的
words.ex: The old king was effete and could not lead.
words.ex_cn: 这位老国王虚弱无能，无法领导。
words.en: No longer productive or effective; lacking the power or will to achieve or succeed.

words.ex: The jeweler crafted a delicate filigree pendant.
words.ex_cn: 珠宝匠制作了一个精致的金银丝细工吊坠。
words.en: Filigree is ornamental work of fine (typically gold or silver) wire formed into delicate tracery.

words.ex: They exalt their hero with cheers.
words.ex_cn: 他们用欢呼赞美他们的英雄。
words.en: To exalt someone or something means to praise them very highly.

words.ex: The lightness of the box made it easy to carry.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的轻便让它很容易携带。
words.en: The quality of being light in weight or not heavy; the quality of being cheerful and carefree.

words.ex: The city is widening the road to reduce traffic.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在加宽道路以减少交通拥堵。
words.en: The process of becoming wider or making something wider.

words.tr: n. 创始人；发起人；传授者；教导者
words.ex: He is the initiator of the new project.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个新项目的发起者。
words.en: An initiator is a person who starts something or causes something to happen.

words.ex: The horror movie showed a man being dismembered.
words.ex_cn: 那部恐怖电影展示了一名男子被肢解。
words.en: To dismember means to cut, tear, or pull the limbs from a body.

words.tr:
n. 誓言；誓约
v. 发誓；起誓
words.ex: He made a vow to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓戒烟。
words.en: A vow is a serious promise or decision to do something.

words.tr: n. 三色旗（尤指法国、爱尔兰的国旗）; adj. 三色的
words.ex: The tricolour flag was flying high above the building.
words.ex_cn: 三色旗在建筑物上方高高飘扬。
words.en: A tricolour is a flag that is divided into three parts of different colors, especially the national flag of France.

words.tr: phrase. 装甲师（二战时期德国的坦克部队编制）
words.ex: The panzer division was a key component of the German military during World War II.
words.ex_cn: 德国装甲师是第二次世界大战期间德国军队的重要组成部分。
words.en: A panzer division is a division in the army that consists primarily of armored vehicles and tanks, designed for rapid movement and powerful attacks.

words.tr:
adj. 阿尔及利亚（人）的；阿尔及利亚语的
n. 阿尔及利亚人；阿尔及利亚语
words.ex: He had an Algerian passport and was traveling on a diplomatic visa.
words.ex_cn: 他持有阿尔及利亚护照，并以外交签证旅行。
words.en: Relating to Algeria or its people.

words.ex: The workers used dynamite to break the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 工人们使用炸药来炸开岩石。
words.en: Dynamite is a type of explosive that is used in mining and construction. It is also used metaphorically to describe something that is highly effective or potentially dangerous.

words.ex: He defeated his opponent in the chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: An opponent is someone who is competing against you in a contest, game, or argument, or someone who is opposed to an idea or plan.

words.ex: It is inconceivable that he forgot his own birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了自己生日，这简直难以想象。
words.en: If something is inconceivable, it is impossible to imagine or believe because it is so unlikely.

words.ex: The smoke came out of the chimney.
words.ex_cn: 烟从烟囱里冒出来。
words.en: A chimney is a pipe through which smoke goes up into the air, usually through the roof of a building.

words.ex: The ant moved its antenna to feel the ground.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁用它的触角感知地面。
words.en: An antenna is a device that sends and receives radio or television signals. In biology, it refers to the long, thin sensory appendages on the heads of insects and crustaceans.

words.ex: The skyscraper is very tall and has many floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座摩天大楼非常高，有很多层。
words.en: A skyscraper is a very tall building that has many floors.

words.ex: She transcended her fears to speak on stage.
words.ex_cn: 她超越了自己的恐惧，在舞台上发言。
words.en: If something transcends normal limits or boundaries, it goes beyond them, because it is more significant than them.

chapters.name: The Eiffel Tower Phrases and expressions

words.tr: 撇开; 搁置，不考虑; 按
words.ex: Leave aside the noise and focus on your work.
words.ex_cn: 把噪音放在一边，专心工作。
words.en: To decide not to discuss or consider something in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 那就更好了；更加好
words.ex: If you can finish the project early, so much the better.
words.ex_cn: 如果你能提前完成项目，那就更好了。
words.en: used to say that if something is the case, it will make a situation even better

words.tr: phrase. 一见钟情；初见即倾心
words.ex: They felt love at first sight when they met in the cafe.
words.ex_cn: 他们在咖啡馆见面时就一见钟情。
words.en: An immediate strong romantic attraction to someone upon first seeing them.

chapters.name: The meaning of architecture New words

words.ex: He writes simple prose every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写简单的散文。
words.en: Prose is written language in its ordinary form, without metrical structure.

words.ex: He loves reading poetry before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡前读诗歌。
words.en: Poetry is the expression of ideas and feelings through the use of distinctive style and rhythm.

words.ex: The sentence has ambiguity because it can mean two things.
words.ex_cn: 这句话有歧义，因为它可以有两种意思。
words.en: If you say that there is ambiguity in something, you mean that it is unclear or confusing, or it can be understood in more than one way.

words.ex: This festival is a regional tradition.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日是一个地区的传统。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a region.

words.ex: The lion returned to its den at night.
words.ex_cn: 狮子晚上回到了它的兽穴。
words.en: A den is the home of certain types of wild animals such as lions or foxes, or a place where someone feels safe and private.

words.ex: The forest is dense with trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林树木茂密。
words.en: Something that is dense contains a lot of things or people in a small area.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.tr: v. 考虑；深思；凝视；思考…的可能性
words.ex: He contemplates quitting his job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在考虑辞去工作。
words.en: If you contemplate an action, you think about whether to do it or not.

words.ex: He ate a moderate amount of food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了适量的食物。
words.en: If you moderate something or if it moderates, it becomes less extreme or violent, or if you moderate a discussion, you help the people in it to reach an agreement.

words.tr: n. 简陋的小屋；水手号子；
words.ex: The fishermen lived in a small shanty by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔民们住在海边的一间简陋小屋里。
words.en: A shanty is a small, crudely built shack or a sailor's work song.

words.ex: The shanty town was a stark reminder of the city's poverty.
words.ex_cn: 棚户区是这个城市贫困的鲜明提醒。
words.en: A shanty town or squatter area is a settlement of improvised buildings known as shanties or shacks, made of plywood, corrugated metal, sheets of plastic, and cardboard boxes. Such settlements are usually found on the periphery of cities, in public parks, or near railroad tracks, rivers, lagoons or city trash dumps.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr: v. 规定；开药方；“prescribe”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 规定的；法定的；
words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for the cough.
words.ex_cn: 医生规定了治疗咳嗽的药物。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.ex: The hard chair caused him discomfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把硬椅子让他感到不舒适。
words.en: Discomfort is a feeling of slight pain or physical unease, or a feeling of worry or embarrassment.

words.tr: v. 向往；渴望；追求；立志
words.ex: He aspires to be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他向往成为一名医生。
words.en: If you aspire to something, you have a strong desire to achieve it or attain it.

words.tr: adj. 期望过高的；过于乐观的
words.ex: His over-optimistic projections led to a financial disaster.
words.ex_cn: 他过于乐观的预测导致了一场财务灾难。
words.en: If you describe someone as over-optimistic, you mean that they are too hopeful about something and do not consider the possible difficulties or problems.

words.tr: n. 占有者; 居住人; 占用者
words.ex: The occupier of the apartment was not at home during the inspection.
words.ex_cn: 公寓的居住者在接受检查时不在家。
words.en: An occupier is a person or organization that occupies a particular place or position.

words.ex: Brutalism is characterized by its raw, unrefined aesthetic.
words.ex_cn: 野兽派艺术以其原始、未经修饰的美学为特征。
words.en: Brutalism is a style of architecture which emerged in the mid-20th century, characterized by the use of raw concrete and bold, block-like forms.

words.tr: phrase. 钢筋混凝土；加筋混凝土
words.ex: The bridge is built with reinforced concrete.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢筋混凝土建造的。
words.en: Reinforced concrete is a composite material in which concrete's relatively low tensile strength and ductility are counteracted by the inclusion of reinforcement having higher tensile strength or ductility.

words.ex: He received criticism for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而受到批评。
words.en: Criticism is the act of expressing disapproval of someone or something and of the faults they have or the mistakes they have made.

words.ex: He is a modernist who loves abstract art.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位喜欢抽象艺术的现代主义者。
words.en: A modernist is someone who follows or supports modern ideas, styles, or methods in art, literature, or religion.

words.ex: He is an idealistic young man who wants to change the world.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个理想主义的年轻人，想要改变世界。
words.en: If you describe someone as idealistic, you mean that they have ideals, and base their behaviour on these ideals, often in a way that is not practical.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.ex: The painting has a simple aesthetic appeal.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种简单的审美吸引力。
words.en: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: He drives on the motorway every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在高速公路上开车。
words.en: A motorway is a wide road specially built for fast travel over long distances, with a limited number of places at which drivers can enter and leave it.

words.tr: n. 悬浮；暂时停职（停学、停赛）；
words.ex: The suspension of dust in the air made the sky look gray.
words.ex_cn: 空气中的尘埃悬浮使天空看起来灰蒙蒙的。
words.en: The act of temporarily stopping something from happening or being in effect, or the state of being stopped in this way.

words.ex: The city's skyline looks beautiful at night.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市的天际线在夜晚看起来很美。
words.en: The outline of land and buildings defined against the sky.

words.ex: The Inuit build an igloo from snow.
words.ex_cn: 因纽特人用雪建造冰屋。
words.en: A dome-shaped Inuit shelter, constructed from blocks of solid snow.

words.tr:
adj. 半球形的；有穹顶的
v. 隆起成穹顶状；“dome”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The church has a domed roof.
words.ex_cn: 这座教堂有一个圆顶屋顶。
words.en: Having a rounded, often hemispherical shape or structure, especially a roof.

words.ex: The view from the mountain is breathtaking.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊叹。
words.en: If you say that something is breathtaking, you mean that it is extremely beautiful or amazing.

words.ex: He is literally the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他确实是队里最好的球员。
words.en: In a literal manner or sense; exactly.

words.tr:
n. 巴洛克式；
adj. 巴洛克式的；
words.ex: The church has a baroque style with gold decorations.
words.ex_cn: 这座教堂具有巴洛克风格，装饰有金色元素。
words.en: Baroque is a style of architecture, music, and art that was common in Europe in the 17th and early 18th centuries, characterized by ornate detail.

words.ex: The problem has too much complexity.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题太复杂了。
words.en: Complexity is the state of having many different parts connected or related to each other in a complicated way.

words.ex: The king ate a sumptuous meal in his palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王在他的宫殿里享用了一顿丰盛的饭菜。
words.en: Something that is sumptuous is very impressive and expensive, especially in a way that involves large amounts of money.

words.ex: He bought a luxury car as an extravagance.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆豪华汽车作为奢侈品。
words.en: Extravagance refers to the spending of more money than is reasonable or than you can afford, or the use of more of something than is necessary.

words.ex: The teacher spoke in a comprehensible way.
words.ex_cn: 老师用容易理解的方式讲话。
words.en: If something is comprehensible, you can understand it.

words.tr: n. 至高无上；最大权力；最高地位；
words.ex: The king claimed supremacy over all other rulers.
words.ex_cn: 国王宣称自己对所有其他统治者拥有至高无上的权力。
words.en: Supremacy is the state or condition of being superior to all others in authority, power, or status.

words.ex: The country enjoys prosperity after years of peace.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在多年的和平后迎来了繁荣。
words.en: Prosperity is a condition in which a person, community, or country is thriving and successful, especially in financial terms.

words.tr:
adj. 高层的（建筑）
n. 高楼；大厦；多层建筑物
words.ex: He lives in a high-rise building near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一栋高楼里。
words.en: A high-rise building is a tall building with many floors.

words.ex: The children skate on the rink every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每个周末都在溜冰场上滑冰。
words.en: A rink is a large area covered with ice where people can go to skate, or a large area of smooth floor where you can skate in a building.

words.ex: His sentiment about the new policy is positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对新政策的看法是积极的。
words.en: A sentiment is a thought, opinion, or idea based on a feeling about a situation, or a way of thinking about something.

words.tr:
n. 崇拜；崇敬；礼拜；
v. 崇拜；尊崇；做礼拜；
words.ex: The ancient people showed worship to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 古人对太阳进行崇拜。
words.en: The feeling or expression of reverence and adoration for a deity.

words.ex: Doctors must follow medical ethics.
words.ex_cn: 医生必须遵守医学道德规范。
words.en: Ethics are moral beliefs and rules about right and wrong.

words.ex: They found paradise on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他们在一个小岛上找到了天堂。
words.en: Paradise is a place of ideal beauty or loveliness, or a state of supreme happiness.

words.tr:
n. （修道院等的）回廊；修道院
v. 关在…（修道院等）里；使…与世隔绝
words.ex: The monks lived a life of quiet contemplation in the cloister.
words.ex_cn: 修道士们在修道院中过着宁静沉思的生活。
words.en: A cloister is a covered walk in a convent, monastery, college, or cathedral, typically with a wall on one side and a colonnade open to a quadrangle on the other.

words.ex: The actors stood in front of the backdrop with a mountain scene.
words.ex_cn: 演员们站在有山景的背景幕布前。
words.en: A backdrop is a large piece of cloth, often with scenery or buildings painted on it, that is hung at the back of a stage in a theatre.

words.ex: The monks live in a quiet monastery.
words.ex_cn: 僧侣们住在一座安静的修道院里。
words.en: A monastery is a building or collection of buildings in which monks live and work.

words.ex: He follows the Ten Commandments.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守十诫。
words.en: A commandment is a rule or order, especially one of the Ten Commandments in the Bible.

words.ex: The temple is a divine place.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙是神的圣地。
words.en: Something that is divine relates to a god or goddess.

words.ex: He is the creator of that popular game.
words.ex_cn: 他是那个流行游戏的创作者。
words.en: A creator is someone who brings something into existence, especially someone who invents or designs something new.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

chapters.name: The meaning of architecture Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 凭自身的权利（或能力、资格、成就等）；本身即具有
words.ex: She is a star in her own right.
words.ex_cn: 她凭自己就成了明星。
words.en: Because of your own efforts, abilities, or qualifications, rather than because of your connection with someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 充分体现…的价值；公正地对待；如实评价
words.ex: This painting does justice to the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画充分展现了自然的美。
words.en: To treat or represent someone or something in a way that is fair and shows their true qualities.

words.tr: 短语动词. 充分反映某人的优点或真实情况；公正地评价某人
words.ex: To do him justice, he's always been honest in his dealings.
words.ex_cn: 公平地说，他在交易中一直都很诚实。
words.en: To treat someone fairly or to represent someone or something in a way that fully shows their good qualities.

words.tr: phrase. 公正地对待；充分展现……的价值或优点
words.ex: This movie does justice to the book.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影忠实地还原了这本书。
words.en: To treat someone or something in a fair or appropriate way; to be adequate or sufficient for something.

chapters.name: Santa Fe, New Mexico New words

words.ex: He is arguably the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 可以说他是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Used when stating an opinion that you believe could be proved true.

words.ex: The village by the lake is picturesque.
words.ex_cn: 湖边的村庄如画般美丽。
words.en: A picturesque place is attractive and interesting, especially in a way that is old-fashioned or unusual.

words.tr: n. 风干土坯；风干砖坯；
words.ex: The old house was built with adobe bricks.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子是用风干土坯砖建造的。
words.en: Adobe is a natural building material made from sand, clay, water, and some kind of fibrous or organic material (sticks, straw, and/or manure), which the builders shape into bricks using frames and dry in the sun.

words.ex: The exterior of the building was covered in stucco.
words.ex_cn: 建筑的外墙覆盖着粉饰灰泥。
words.en: A type of plaster used for coating walls and ceilings, or for making architectural decorations.

words.ex: She chose earth-tone colors for her living room to create a warm and natural atmosphere.
words.ex_cn: 她为客厅选择了大地色调来营造温暖自然的氛围。
words.en: A color that is characteristic of earthy substances, such as browns, tans, and greens.

words.tr:
n. 晒成棕褐色的肤色
adj. 棕褐色的；棕黄色的
v. 将皮肤晒成棕褐色
words.ex: He has a deep tan after spending the week at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩度过一周后，皮肤晒成了深棕色。
words.en: If you tan, or if the sun tans you, your skin becomes darker because you spend time in the sun.

words.ex: The satellite beams signals to Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星向地球发射信号。
words.en: A beam is a long, thick piece of wood, metal, or concrete that is used to support the roof of a building. It can also refer to a line of light that shines from a bright object, or a smile that shows someone is very happy.

words.ex: Europeans colonized many parts of Africa in the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 欧洲人在19世纪开拓了非洲的许多地区。
words.en: To colonize means to send people to live in and govern another country.

words.ex: Children play in the plaza after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在广场上玩耍。
words.en: A plaza is an open public space that is found in the heart of a city or town. It is often surrounded by buildings and may include shops, restaurants, and other amenities.

words.ex: His nationality is Canadian.
words.ex_cn: 他的国籍是加拿大人。
words.en: Nationality is the legal relationship between an individual and a state, often used to refer to the country to which a person belongs.

words.ex: The revival of traditional music brought joy to many people.
words.ex_cn: 传统音乐的复兴给许多人带来了快乐。
words.en: The process of something becoming popular or active again after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: He conform to the rules of the school.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守学校的规章制度。
words.en: To conform means to behave in a way that is accepted by most people or to obey a rule, law, or custom.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.ex: They eat at an upscale restaurant every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周末都在一家高档餐厅吃饭。
words.en: If you describe something as upscale, you mean it is of high quality or intended for people who are wealthy.

words.ex: She bought a dress from a small boutique downtown.
words.ex_cn: 她在市中心的一家小型时装精品屋买了一条裙子。
words.en: A boutique is a small shop that sells stylish clothes, shoes, or jewelry.

words.tr: n. 迪士尼乐园（美国加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆市的一个主题公园，由华特·迪士尼创建）；
words.ex: We went to Disneyland last summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们去年夏天去了迪士尼乐园。
words.en: Disneyland is a theme park in Anaheim, California, created by Walt Disney and opened in 1955. It is known for its attractions, entertainment, and characters from Disney films.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.tr: v. 集中；形成中心；中央集权
words.ex: The company will centralize its offices in one city.
words.ex_cn: 公司将会把办公室集中到一个城市。
words.en: To centralize means to bring something under central control or to make something the center of attention or activity.

words.ex: She blends flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To mix substances together so that they combine into a single substance.

chapters.name: Longitude New words

words.ex: The ship's longitude is 45 degrees west.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的经度是西经45度。
words.en: Longitude is the distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian, measured in degrees.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.tr: adj. 串珠状的；粒状的；带珠的
words.ex: Her dress was beaded with tiny pearls.
words.ex_cn: 她的连衣裙上饰有细小的珍珠。
words.en: Decorated with or as if with beads.

words.ex: She picked up the coil of rope from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 她从地上捡起了那卷绳子。
words.en: A coil is a length of something wound in a joined sequence of loops, or the act of winding something into loops.

words.ex: The tree has a hollow trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干是中空的。
words.en: If something is hollow, it has an empty space inside it.

words.ex: The ball is a perfect sphere.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是一个完美的球体。
words.en: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional shape, like a ball. It can also refer to a particular area of interest, activity, or knowledge.

words.ex: The two lines intersect at point A.
words.ex_cn: 两条线在点A相交。
words.en: If two or more lines or roads intersect, they meet or cross each other.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.tr: adv. 随意地； 偶然地； 任意地； 杂乱地
words.ex: He placed the books haphazardly on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书随意地放在书架上。
words.en: If something is done haphazardly, it is done in a way that is not planned or organized, and so may be done badly or not successfully.

words.ex: The statue is made of bronze.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由青铜制成。
words.en: Bronze is a yellowish-brown metal which is a mixture of copper and tin.

words.ex: The glass orb sat on the table.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃球放在桌子上。
words.en: An orb is a spherical object or shape, especially a celestial body like a planet or the moon.

words.tr: adj. 透明的，极薄的 n. 透视装
words.ex: She wore a see-through blouse that revealed her bra.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件透明的衬衫，露出了胸罩。
words.en: Allowing one to see through it; transparent or translucent.

words.ex: The dragon is an imaginary creature.
words.ex_cn: 龙是一种想象中的生物。
words.en: An imaginary person, place, or thing is one that does not exist or is not real, but that people think about or talk about.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.tr:
n. 黄道
adj. 黄道的
words.ex: The ecliptic is the path the sun seems to take across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 黄道是太阳在天空中看起来经过的路径。
words.en: The ecliptic is the apparent path of the Sun on the celestial sphere, and is the basis for the ecliptic coordinate system.

words.tr:
n. 回归线；热带
adj. 热带的
words.ex: The Tropic of Cancer is north of the equator.
words.ex_cn: 北回归线在赤道以北。
words.en: The tropics are the region of the Earth surrounding the Equator. They are delimited in latitude by the Tropic of Cancer in the Northern Hemisphere at 23°26′10.0″ (or 23.4361°) N and the Tropic of Capricorn in the Southern Hemisphere at 23°26′10.0″ (or 23.4361°) S; these latitudes correspond to the axial tilt of the Earth.

words.ex: The prime meridian passes through Greenwich, England.
words.ex_cn: 本初子午线穿过英国格林尼治。
words.en: A meridian is an imaginary great circle on the earth's surface passing through the north and south poles at right angles to the equator, or the highest point reached by a celestial or other object.

words.ex: The prime meridian is the line of 0° longitude, from which other longitudes are measured.
words.ex_cn: 本初子午线是0°经线，其他经度从这里开始测量。
words.en: The prime meridian is the meridian (a line of longitude) in a geographic coordinate system at which longitude is defined to be 0°. Together, a prime meridian and its anti-meridian (the 180th meridian in a 360°-system) form a great circle.

words.ex: The city improved its power grid to handle more electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改进了其电力输送网，以承载更多的电力。
words.en: A grid is a pattern of straight lines that cross each other to form squares. It is used to help you draw or to help you find places on a map.

words.tr: n. 结构；布局；配置；外形
words.ex: The configuration of the computer is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑的配置非常简单。
words.en: The arrangement of parts or elements in a particular form, figure, or combination.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.tr:
adv. 漂流地；漫无目的地
adj. 漂泊的；漫无目的的；脱落的
words.ex: The boat was adrift in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 小船在海上漂流。
words.en: If something is adrift, it is floating on the water and not fastened to anything or controlled by anyone.

words.ex: He repeatedly asked for help.
words.ex_cn: 他再三地请求帮助。
words.en: If something is done repeatedly, it is done again and again.

words.tr: v. 重新描绘；重新拟定
words.ex: He will redraw the map after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，他将重新绘制地图。
words.en: To draw or draft something again, especially after changes have been made.

words.tr:
n. 紧身褡；腰带；围绕物
v. 以腰带束缚；围绕
words.ex: She wore a girdle to look slimmer.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条束腰裙来显得更苗条。
words.en: A girdle is a piece of women's underwear that fits tightly around the stomach, hips, and bottom.

words.ex: The circles are concentric and share the same center.
words.ex_cn: 这些圆是同心的，拥有同一个中心。
words.en: Having a common center, as circles or spheres.

words.ex: The two roads converge at the town center.
words.ex_cn: 这两条路在镇中心交汇。
words.en: If roads or lines converge, they meet or join at a particular place.

words.tr:
adj. 十字形的；交叉的
adv. 十字形地；交叉着
v. 划十字；纵横交错
words.ex: The criss-cross lines on the paper made a net.
words.ex_cn: 纸上的十字形线条形成了一个网。
words.en: To move back and forth over something, or to mark something with lines that cross each other.

words.tr: n. 制图员；地图绘制员
words.ex: The cartographer drew a map of the island.
words.ex_cn: 这位制图师画了一张岛屿的地图。
words.en: A cartographer is a person who draws or produces maps.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.tr: adj. 按字母顺序的；字母的；
words.ex: The names are listed in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些名字是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: In the order of the letters of the alphabet.

words.ex: He sits in the armchair and reads the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在扶手椅上读报纸。
words.en: An armchair is a comfortable chair with sides that support your arms.

words.ex: He had a misconception that the earth is flat.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个错误认识，认为地球是平的。
words.en: A misconception is an idea that is not correct because it is based on a misunderstanding or a wrong belief.

words.tr: n. （名词）畸形状态：遭致变形后的状态
words.ex: The accident caused a deformity in his leg.
words.ex_cn: 事故导致他的腿变形。
words.en: A deformity is a part of someone's body that is not the normal shape because of injury, illness, or because they were born that way.

words.tr: adv. 任意地; 武断地
words.ex: He chose the number arbitrarily.
words.ex_cn: 他随意地选了这个数字。
words.en: If something is done arbitrarily, it is done without any reason or system, often in a way that is unfair.

words.tr: n. 前任；前辈；原有事物
words.ex: He became the new manager, replacing his predecessor.
words.ex_cn: 他成为了新经理，接替了他的前任。
words.en: A predecessor is someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series.

words.ex: The sky looks heavenly at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时天空看起来像天上的。
words.en: If you describe something as heavenly, you mean that it is extremely pleasant or enjoyable.

words.tr: n. 实习工作；安排；放置；
words.ex: He got a placement at a local company this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天获得了一份在本地公司的实习工作。
words.en: The act of placing something or someone in a particular position or the process of finding a suitable place or job for someone.

words.tr: phrase. 儿童游戏；轻而易举的事
words.ex: For him, solving that math problem was child's play.
words.ex_cn: 对他来说，解决那个数学问题非常容易。
words.en: Something that is very easy to do.

words.tr:
n. 树桩；残段；残根
v. 难倒；重步走
words.ex: The tree stump is still in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 树桩还在院子里。
words.en: A stump is the base part of a tree that remains after the rest of the tree has been cut down. It can also refer to a difficult problem or to the act of walking heavily.

words.ex: The teacher intervened when the students argued.
words.ex_cn: 当学生们争吵时，老师进行了干涉。
words.en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

words.ex: The navigator helped the ship find its way.
words.ex_cn: 领航员帮助船找到了航向。
words.en: A navigator is someone who is skilled in planning and directing the route of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments and maps.

words.ex: The map shows geographical features like mountains and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山脉和河流等地貌特征。
words.en: Relating to the study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: He reset the password to log in again.
words.ex_cn: 他重置了密码以便再次登录。
words.en: To set again or differently; to adjust or fix in a new or different way.

words.ex: There is a discrepancy between the two reports.
words.ex_cn: 这两份报告之间有差异。
words.en: A discrepancy is a difference between two or more things that should be the same.

words.tr: n. 围长；周长；肚带；腰围
words.ex: The tree has a large girth.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干很粗。
words.en: The distance around something, especially the middle part of a person's body or a tree.

words.ex: The car has high mileage.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车行驶的英里数很高。
words.en: Mileage refers to the distance traveled, measured in miles, or the benefits or advantages gained from a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: You need basic math as a prerequisite for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你学习这门课程的前提是掌握基础数学。
words.en: A prerequisite is something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen.

words.ex: He checks the time on his wristwatch.
words.ex_cn: 他看下手表上的时间。
words.en: A wristwatch is a small clock that you wear on a strap around your wrist.

words.ex: The pendulum swings back and forth in the clock.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆在钟里来回摆动。
words.en: A pendulum is a weight that is hung from a fixed point so that it can swing freely, especially a rod with a weight at the end that regulates the mechanism of a clock.

words.tr: phrase. 在途中；在运输过程中
words.ex: We are en route to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在去机场的路上。
words.en: On the way to a destination.

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.tr: v. （使）变厚；变稠；使（情节等）复杂
words.ex: The soup will thicken if you cook it longer.
words.ex_cn: 如果你多煮一会儿，汤会变稠。
words.en: To make or become thick or thicker.

words.ex: Oil helps to lubricate the engine parts.
words.ex_cn: 油有助于润滑发动机部件。
words.en: To apply a substance such as oil or grease to (something) in order to minimize friction and allow smooth movement.

words.tr: phrase. 润滑油；用于减少摩擦的油性液体
words.ex: The engine requires regular replacement of lubricating oil to function properly.
words.ex_cn: 发动机需要定期更换润滑油以正常工作。
words.en: A substance, typically a liquid, used to reduce friction between surfaces in mutual contact, thereby reducing the heat generated when the surfaces move.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.ex: The barometric pressure was steadily dropping, indicating an incoming storm.
words.ex_cn: 气压在稳步下降，表明暴风雨即将来临。
words.en: Relating to the measurement of atmospheric pressure.

words.ex: The barometric pressure is rising, which usually indicates clear weather ahead.
words.ex_cn: 气压正在上升，这通常预示着天气将会晴朗。
words.en: The atmospheric pressure as indicated by a barometer.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.ex: The exploration of space takes many years.
words.ex_cn: 太空探索需要很多年。
words.en: The act of searching for the purpose of discovery of information or resources.

words.tr: adv. 不管愿不愿意地；乱七八糟地；无计划地; adj. 不管愿不愿意的；乱七八糟的
words.ex: The project was completed willy-nilly, with no clear plan.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目无计划地完成了，没有明确的计划。
words.en: If something happens willy-nilly, it happens whether people want it to or not, often in a way that is not organized or planned.

chapters.name: Longitude Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 时间的流逝（常用于文学或比喻语境，指时间如沙漏中的沙子般不可逆转地消逝）
words.ex: As the sands of time slip away, we realize the importance of cherishing every moment.
words.ex_cn: 随着时间的流逝，我们意识到珍惜每一刻的重要性。
words.en: The phrase 'the sands of time' is used to refer to the passage of time, often in a poetic or metaphorical sense.

words.tr: phrase. （某物的）大部分；主要部分
words.ex: She spent the better part of her day reading in the library.
words.ex_cn: 她大部分时间都在图书馆里读书。
words.en: The phrase 'the better part of sth.' is used to indicate that something constitutes the majority or a significant portion of a particular thing or period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 称职的；胜任的；值得所获报酬的（字面意为“配得上自己的盐”，源自古罗马士兵以盐作为薪酬的一部分）
words.ex: A teacher worth her salt always helps students learn.
words.ex_cn: 一个称职的老师总是帮助学生学习。
words.en: If you say, for example, that any doctor worth his or her salt would do something, you mean that any doctor who is good at his or her job or who deserves respect would do it.

chapters.name: The storm New words

words.tr: adj. 无数的；多的；数不清的；
words.ex: There are countless stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数颗星星。
words.en: Too numerous to count.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.tr: adj. 无法触及的；摸不着的；难解的
words.ex: The concept of infinity is often considered impalpable.
words.ex_cn: 无限的概念常常被认为是难以理解的。
words.en: Impalpable means something that cannot be perceived by touch or is very difficult to understand or define.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.ex: She had only the faintest inkling of what he was planning.
words.ex_cn: 她对他正在策划的事情只有一点模糊的概念。
words.en: An inkling is a slight knowledge or suspicion of something.

words.tr:
adv. 不；不仅如此；而且 
n. 反对票
words.ex: They said nay to the proposal.
words.ex_cn: 他们对提议投了反对票。
words.en: Used to introduce a more precise or explicit statement, or to emphasize a point just made.

words.ex: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom in a molecule.
words.ex_cn: 水由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成一个分子。
words.en: A molecule is the smallest particle in a chemical element or compound that has the chemical properties of that element or compound. Molecules are made up of atoms that are held together by chemical bonds.

words.ex: The duck walked on the mudbank near the river.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在河边的泥滩上行走。
words.en: A mudbank is a raised area of mud, especially at the edge of a river or the sea, which is often exposed at low tide.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；人口稠密的
words.ex: There are multitudinous stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数的星星。
words.en: If you describe something as multitudinous, you mean that it is very large in number.

words.ex: The lion opened its maw wide.
words.ex_cn: 狮子张开了大口。
words.en: The stomach or the throat of an animal, especially a carnivore, or something resembling it in shape or function.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: He worked here previously.
words.ex_cn: 他以前在这里工作。
words.en: At an earlier time or before.

words.ex: He paints on a canvas with oil colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用油画颜料在帆布上作画。
words.en: A strong, coarse unbleached cloth made from hemp, flax, cotton, or a similar yarn, used to make items such as sails and tents and as a surface for oil painting.

words.ex: The old schooner sailed slowly across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧的双桅帆船缓缓地驶过大海。
words.en: A schooner is a type of sailing vessel with two or more masts, with the foremast being shorter than the mainmast.

words.ex: The ice cream is in a conical cup.
words.ex_cn: 冰淇淋装在一个圆锥形的杯子里。
words.en: Something that is conical is in the shape of a cone.

words.tr:
n. 马笼头；缰绳；约束
v. 套笼头；表示恼怒；抑制
words.ex: He pulled the bridle to stop the horse.
words.ex_cn: 他拉了一下缰绳让马停下来。
words.en: A bridle is a set of straps that fits around a horse's head and is used to control the horse. As a verb, to bridle means to put a bridle on a horse or to restrain or control something.

words.tr:
adj. 垂直的；笔直的
n. 垂直线
words.ex: The lines are perpendicular to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些线互相垂直。
words.en: At right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line; vertical.

words.ex: The mechanic replaced the broken gasket in the engine.
words.ex_cn: 机械师更换了发动机中损坏的垫圈。
words.en: A gasket is a flat piece of soft material that you put between two joined surfaces in a pipe or engine in order to make sure that gas and oil cannot escape.

words.ex: The topmast broke in the strong wind.
words.ex_cn: 在强风中，顶桅杆折断了。
words.en: A topmast is a mast on a ship above the lower mast and below the topgallant mast.

words.tr:
n. 抽奖售物
v. 抽奖赠送（货品）
words.ex: He bought a ticket for the raffle.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张抽奖票。
words.en: A raffle is a type of lottery in which people buy tickets for a chance to win a prize.

words.tr:
adj. 麻木的；失去知觉的
v. 使麻木；使迟钝
words.ex: His fingers felt numb after being in the cold.
words.ex_cn: 他的手指在寒冷中变得麻木。
words.en: If a part of your body is numb, you cannot feel it, usually for a short time.

words.tr: adj. 瘫痪的；麻痹的； v. “paralyze”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The accident left him paralyzed.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他瘫痪了。
words.en: Unable to move or act; rendered powerless or ineffective.

words.ex: He had to endure the cold winter without a coat.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不在没有外套的情况下忍受寒冷的冬天。
words.en: To endure means to suffer something difficult, unpleasant, or painful, or to continue to exist for a long time.

words.ex: There was a lull in the rain before the storm came back.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨再次来临前，雨下了一阵间歇。
words.en: A lull is a short period of quiet or calm in an otherwise noisy or hectic situation. To lull means to cause someone to feel calm or to fall asleep.

words.tr:
adj. 使人厌恶的；令人不快的；令人恶心的
v. 患病；恶心；（使）厌倦；“sicken”的现在分词
words.ex: The smell of rotten food is sickening.
words.ex_cn: 腐烂食物的气味令人作呕。
words.en: If you describe something as sickening, you mean that it makes you feel disgusted or horrified.

words.ex: The concert was terrific!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something or someone as terrific, you are very pleased with them or very impressed by them.

words.tr: adj. 肌肉的；肌肉发达的；
words.ex: He has a muscular arm from lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他因为举重而拥有强壮的手臂。
words.en: Relating to or affecting the muscles; having well-developed muscles.

words.ex: The car stopped at the verge of the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在了道路的边缘。
words.en: The edge or border of something; to be close to a certain state or condition.

words.tr: adv. 无法抵抗地，不能自持地; 极为诱惑人地
words.ex: The cake looked irresistibly delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕看起来诱人极了。
words.en: In a manner that is impossible to resist; very attractively.

words.ex: The bottle has a cork stopper.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子有一个软木塞。
words.en: Cork is a light, porous material obtained from the bark of the cork oak tree, used especially for making stoppers for bottles.

words.ex: The stability of the table prevents it from wobbling.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的固定防止它摇晃。
words.en: The state of being stable; the quality of being unchanging.

words.tr: adj. 发狂的；狂热的；疯狂的
words.ex: He had a maniacal glint in his eyes as he spoke about his new project.
words.ex_cn: 他谈起自己的新项目时，眼中闪烁着狂热的光芒。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as maniacal, you mean that it is extremely wild and often violent because they are mentally ill or very angry.

words.tr: n. 引人注目的人或物；溅污的斑点；
words.ex: The new singer became a splash on the music scene.
words.ex_cn: 这位新歌手成为了音乐界引人注目的人物。
words.en: To cause (a liquid) to scatter in drops or small quantities, especially by striking or moving suddenly; to move or strike so as to cause a liquid to scatter in this way.

words.tr: n. 桅顶，报头 vt. 升至桅顶
words.ex: His name is on the masthead of the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字出现在报纸的报头上。
words.en: The masthead is the top of a ship's mast or the title of a newspaper or magazine at the top of the front page.

words.tr:
n. 喷口；水管；水柱
v. 喷出；滔滔不绝地说
words.ex: The kettle has a small spout for pouring water.
words.ex_cn: 这个水壶有一个小喷口用来倒水。
words.en: If something spouts liquid or fire, or if liquid or fire spout out of something, it comes out very quickly with a lot of force.

words.tr:
v. 挤；推；撞；争夺
n. 挤拥；推撞
words.ex: People jostle in the crowded market.
words.ex_cn: 人们在拥挤的市场里推挤。
words.en: To jostle someone means to push or knock against them, usually in a crowd.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: He has visited his grandma thrice this year.
words.ex_cn: 他今年已经去过奶奶家三次了。
words.en: Three times; on three occasions.

words.ex: The strange noise confounded the children.
words.ex_cn: 奇怪的声音让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: To confuse and surprise someone, especially by being difficult to understand or deal with.

words.ex: The country fell into anarchy after the war.
words.ex_cn: 战争之后，这个国家陷入了混乱。
words.en: Anarchy is a state of disorder due to absence or nonrecognition of authority or other controlling systems.

words.ex: The dog fell into a deep pit.
words.ex_cn: 狗掉进了一个深坑。
words.en: A pit is a large hole in the ground, either natural or as a result of digging. It can also refer to a hollow or indentation in a surface, or a place where something is extracted, such as a mine. As a verb, to pit means to set someone or something in competition or to make a hollow or indentation in a surface.

words.tr:
n. 无宗教信仰者；异教徒
adj. 不信教的；异教徒的
words.ex: The villagers thought he was a heathen because he didn't pray.
words.ex_cn: 村民们认为他是一个异教徒，因为他不祈祷。
words.en: A heathen is a person who does not belong to a widely held religion (especially one who is not a Christian, Jew, or Muslim) as regarded by those who do.

words.ex: The child ripped the paper with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用手把纸撕裂了。
words.en: To rip something means to tear it quickly and forcefully.

words.ex: The orange was squeezed into a sweet pulp.
words.ex_cn: 橙子被榨成了甜美的浆状物。
words.en: The soft, wet, shapeless mass of material that is left after the juice has been removed from fruit or vegetables, or the soft inner part of a tooth.

words.ex: He smashed the glass with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把玻璃打碎了。
words.en: To break something into pieces violently and noisily, or to cause something to do this by dropping, throwing, or hitting it.

words.ex: He used dry leaves as kindling to start the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他用干树叶作为引火物来生火。
words.en: Material that burns easily and is used for starting a fire.

words.tr: v. 消灭；歼灭；彻底击败
words.ex: The bomb will annihilate the building.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹会摧毁那栋大楼。
words.en: To annihilate something means to destroy it completely.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: He smiled at the recollection of his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他回忆起童年时微笑了。
words.en: The act of remembering something or the ability to remember.

words.ex: He lost consciousness after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了意识。
words.en: The state of being aware of and able to think about oneself, one's surroundings, and one's experiences.

chapters.name: The storm Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 到达；显现；实现；成功地完成；（健康）恢复；渡过
words.ex: The package will come through tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 包裹明天会到达。
words.en: To successfully deal with a difficult situation or to do what is needed or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 接近于；濒临于；在···边缘
words.ex: He is on the verge of crying.
words.ex_cn: 他快要哭了。
words.en: If you are on the verge of something, you are very close to experiencing it.

words.tr: phrase. 跳起来；发生；迅速发展
words.ex: The ball springs up when it hits the ground.
words.ex_cn: 球碰到地面时跳起来。
words.en: To appear or develop quickly and/or suddenly.

words.ex: The old chair will fall apart if you sit on it.
words.ex_cn: 如果你坐在那把旧椅子上，它就会散架。
words.en: If something falls apart, it breaks into pieces because it is old or badly made.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒；到达；总计；突然想起
words.ex: He came to after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If someone comes to, they regain consciousness after being unconscious. It can also mean to reach a particular state or condition, or to be involved in something.

chapters.name: Apollo 13 New words

words.ex: The software has five different modules.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件有五个不同的模块。
words.en: A module is one of the separate parts of a course of study, especially at a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 登月舱；月球着陆器
words.ex: The astronauts landed the lunar module on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员将登月舱降落在月球上。
words.en: The part of a spacecraft that is designed to carry astronauts from the command module to the surface of the moon and back.

words.ex: Originally, he wanted to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他想当一名老师。
words.en: Initially; in the first place; in a novel or inventive manner.

words.ex: The team has a strong backup for the captain.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍有一位强大的后援来代替队长。
words.en: A backup is a copy of a file or other item of data made in case the original is lost or damaged. It can also refer to support or assistance provided to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 风疹（德国麻疹），一种由病毒引起的轻型传染病，症状包括发热和皮疹
words.ex: He had german measles when he was a child.
words.ex_cn: 他小时候得了德国麻疹。
words.en: German measles is a mild infectious disease that causes a rash and fever, especially dangerous for pregnant women as it can cause birth defects.

words.ex: The injury led to a complication in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤使他的康复过程复杂化了。
words.en: A complication is a problem or difficulty that makes a situation harder to deal with.

words.tr: adj. 不确定的；不肯定的；无把握的；
words.ex: I am unsure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案不确定。
words.en: If you are unsure about something, you are not certain about it.

words.tr: adv. 妥善保管地；安全地；稳妥地；安全地；
words.ex: She safely stored her jewelry in a safe.
words.ex_cn: 她妥善保管地把珠宝存放在保险箱里。
words.en: In a way that is not likely to cause harm or damage; securely.

words.ex: The sailors jumped into the lifeboat.
words.ex_cn: 水手们跳进了救生艇。
words.en: A lifeboat is a small boat that is carried on a ship and is used for escaping if the ship sinks or is in danger.

words.tr:
v. 丢弃；放弃；扔掉
n. 投弃；抛弃；投弃货物
words.ex: The pilot had to jettison extra fuel to land safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员不得不抛掉多余的燃料以安全着陆。
words.en: To jettison something means to throw it away or get rid of it, usually because it is not wanted or needed.

words.ex: The signal transmission is clear and strong.
words.ex_cn: 信号传输清晰而强劲。
words.en: The act or process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or thing to another.
